"""Rule-based dispatcher/couriers; agents exchange only durable queue events."""

from typing import Any

import networkx as nx
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from delivery.contractors import communication, eligible, fleet_contract
from delivery.customer_service import Advice, refund_policy
from delivery.db import Connection
from delivery.dispatch_optimizer import Candidate, optimize_dispatch
from delivery.dispatch_policy import (
    assignment_score,
    fair_ranks,
    load_policy,
    operating_cost,
    prioritize_deadlines,
)
from delivery.queue import Event, publish
from delivery.world import ENERGY_PER_KM, World, depart_at, position, route_progress, trace


class Dispatcher:
    def __init__(self, world: World) -> None:
        self.world = world

    def handle(self, conn: Connection, event: Event) -> None:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (event.run_id,)).fetchone()
        assert row
        sim = row["sim_time"]
        policy = load_policy(row["dispatch_config"])
        pending = conn.execute(
            """SELECT o.*, coalesce(o.recovery_node,s.node) AS store_node, c.node AS customer_node,
               s.district AS store_district,c.district AS customer_district
               FROM orders o JOIN locations s ON s.id=o.store JOIN locations c ON c.id=o.customer
               WHERE o.run_id=%s AND o.status='pending' AND NOT EXISTS 
               (SELECT 1 FROM store_orders so WHERE so.run_id=o.run_id AND so.order_id=o.id 
                AND so.stage NOT IN ('dock','handed_off')) ORDER BY o.due_sim,o.id
               FOR UPDATE OF o SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100""",
            (event.run_id,),
        ).fetchall()
        couriers = conn.execute(
            """SELECT c.*,h.district AS home_district FROM couriers c
               JOIN locations h ON h.id=c.hub WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.status='idle'
               AND c.energy>10 AND c.shift_end>%s ORDER BY c.idle_since_sim,c.completed_jobs,c.id
               FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100""",
            (event.run_id, sim),
        ).fetchall()
        routes: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, Any]] = {}
        from delivery.chaos import active_events, retime, traffic_factor

        disruptions = (
            active_events(conn, str(event.run_id)) if row["chaos_config"] is not None else []
        )
        scores: dict[tuple[str, str], dict[str, float]] = {}
        candidates = []
        ranks = fair_ranks(couriers, f"{row['seed']}:{sim}")
        for order in pending:
            for courier in couriers:
                contract = fleet_contract(row["fleet_config"], courier["fleet_id"])
                if not eligible(contract, courier, order):
                    continue
                try:
                    route = self.world.route(
                        courier["node"],
                        order["store_node"],
                        order["customer_node"],
                        courier["mode"],
                        sim,
                        order["ready_sim"],
                    )
                    if disruptions:
                        route = retime(route, sim, traffic_factor(disruptions, order))
                except (nx.NetworkXNoPath, nx.NodeNotFound):
                    continue
                required = route["distance_m"] / 1000 * ENERGY_PER_KM[courier["mode"]]
                if courier["energy"] - required >= 5 and route["end_at"] <= courier["shift_end"]:
                    pair = order["id"], courier["id"]
                    routes[pair] = route
                    score = assignment_score(route, courier["mode"], sim, order["due_sim"], policy)
                    scores[pair] = score
                    candidates.append(
                        Candidate(*pair, round(score["total"] * 1000), ranks[courier["id"]])
                    )
        if policy.strategy == "legacy":
            # A frozen reference for same-demand A/B evaluations.
            selected = []
            used: set[str] = set()
            for order in pending:
                options = [
                    c for c in candidates if c.order_id == order["id"] and c.courier_id not in used
                ]
                if options:
                    chosen = min(
                        options,
                        key=lambda c: (routes[c.order_id, c.courier_id]["end_at"], c.courier_id),
                    )
                    selected.append(chosen)
                    used.add(chosen.courier_id)
        else:
            selected = list(
                optimize_dispatch(
                    prioritize_deadlines(
                        candidates,
                        [o["id"] for o in pending],
                    )
                )
            )
        orders_by_id = {o["id"]: o for o in pending}
        couriers_by_id = {c["id"]: c for c in couriers}
        for chosen in selected:
            order, courier = orders_by_id[chosen.order_id], couriers_by_id[chosen.courier_id]
            route = routes[chosen.order_id, chosen.courier_id]
            cost = operating_cost(route["distance_m"], courier["mode"], job=True)
            changed = conn.execute(
                """UPDATE orders SET status='assigned',courier=%s,assigned_sim=%s,route=%s,
                   route_m=%s,cost_eur=%s,version=version+1
                   WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s AND status='pending' RETURNING id""",
                (
                    courier["id"],
                    sim,
                    Jsonb(route),
                    route["distance_m"],
                    cost,
                    event.run_id,
                    order["id"],
                ),
            ).fetchone()
            if not changed:
                continue
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE couriers SET status='reserved',leg_accounted_m=0,leg_empty_accounted_m=0 "
                "WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                (event.run_id, courier["id"]),
            )
            publish(
                conn,
                run_id=event.run_id,
                producer="dispatcher",
                topic="courier.assigned",
                payload={
                    "order_id": order["id"],
                    "courier_id": courier["id"],
                    "fleet_id": courier["fleet_id"],
                },
                key=f"assignment:{order['id']}:{order['version'] + 1}",
                trace_id=order["id"],
                parent_id=event.id,
                due_sim=sim,
                priority=5,
            )
            trace(
                conn,
                str(event.run_id),
                sim,
                "dispatcher",
                "assigned",
                {
                    "rule": policy.strategy,
                    "fleet": fleet_contract(row["fleet_config"], courier["fleet_id"]),
                    "objective": (
                        "max served; earliest deadlines; min cost; longest idle/fewer jobs"
                        if policy.strategy == "min_cost"
                        else "earliest completion, then courier ID"
                    ),
                    "eligible_couriers": sum(c.order_id == order["id"] for c in candidates),
                    "batch_orders": len(pending),
                    "batch_couriers": len(couriers),
                    "score": scores[chosen.order_id, chosen.courier_id],
                    "alternatives": [
                        {
                            "courier": c.courier_id,
                            "score": scores[c.order_id, c.courier_id],
                            "pickup_m": round(
                                routes[c.order_id, c.courier_id]["pickup_distance_m"]
                            ),
                            "fair_rank": c.tie_break_rank,
                        }
                        for c in sorted(
                            (c for c in candidates if c.order_id == order["id"]),
                            key=lambda c: (c.cost, c.tie_break_rank),
                        )[:5]
                    ],
                    "start_node": courier["node"],
                    "pickup_distance_m": round(route["pickup_distance_m"]),
                    "operating_cost_eur": round(cost, 4),
                    "eta_sim": route["end_at"],
                    "distance_m": round(route["distance_m"]),
                    "version": order["version"] + 1,
                },
                order["id"],
                courier["id"],
                event.id,
            )
        if policy.reposition == "demand_aware" and not pending:
            from delivery.dispatch_reposition import reposition_idle

            reposition_idle(conn, event, self.world, row, policy)


def courier_trace(
    conn: Connection,
    run: str,
    sim: int,
    agent: str,
    action: str,
    detail: dict[str, Any],
    order: str | None = None,
    courier: str | None = None,
    event: int | None = None,
) -> None:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT c.fleet_id,r.fleet_config FROM couriers c JOIN runs r ON r.id=c.run_id "
        "WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.id=%s",
        (run, courier),
    ).fetchone()
    assert row and courier
    message = communication(
        fleet_contract(row["fleet_config"], row["fleet_id"]),
        courier,
        action,
        order=order,
        eta_sim=detail.get("eta_sim"),
    )
    trace(conn, run, sim, agent, action, {**detail, "message": message}, order, courier, event)


class Courier:
    def handle(self, conn: Connection, event: Event) -> None:
        courier = event.payload["courier_id"]
        if event.topic == "courier.reposition":
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT c.*,r.sim_time,r.duration FROM couriers c JOIN runs r ON r.id=c.run_id "
                "WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.id=%s AND c.status='reposition_reserved' FOR UPDATE OF c",
                (event.run_id, courier),
            ).fetchone()
            if not row:
                return
            delay = max(0, row["sim_time"] - row["reposition_route"]["start_at"])
            route = depart_at(row["reposition_route"], row["sim_time"])
            if route["end_at"] + 600 > min(row["duration"], row["shift_end"]):
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE couriers SET status='idle',reposition_route=NULL "
                    "WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                    (event.run_id, courier),
                )
                publish(
                    conn,
                    run_id=event.run_id,
                    producer="courier",
                    topic="courier.available",
                    payload={"courier_id": courier},
                    key=f"reposition-cancelled:{event.id}",
                    trace_id=event.trace_id,
                    parent_id=event.id,
                    due_sim=row["sim_time"],
                )
                courier_trace(
                    conn,
                    str(event.run_id),
                    row["sim_time"],
                    "courier",
                    "reposition_cancelled",
                    {"reason": "delayed handoff exceeds shift/run horizon", "distance_m": 0},
                    courier=courier,
                    event=event.id,
                )
                return
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE couriers SET status='repositioning',reposition_route=%s "
                "WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                (Jsonb(route), event.run_id, courier),
            )
            courier_trace(
                conn,
                str(event.run_id),
                row["sim_time"],
                "courier",
                "reposition_accepted",
                {"queue_delay_seconds": delay, "departure_sim": route["start_at"]},
                courier=courier,
                event=event.id,
            )
            return
        order = conn.execute(
            """SELECT o.*,r.sim_time,r.duration,c.shift_end FROM orders o
               JOIN runs r ON r.id=o.run_id
               JOIN couriers c ON c.run_id=o.run_id AND c.id=o.courier
               WHERE o.run_id=%s AND o.id=%s AND o.courier=%s AND o.status='assigned'
               AND c.status='reserved' FOR UPDATE OF o,c""",
            (event.run_id, event.payload["order_id"], courier),
        ).fetchone()
        if not order:
            return
        route = depart_at(order["route"], order["sim_time"], order["ready_sim"])
        if route["end_at"] > min(order["duration"], order["shift_end"]):
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE orders SET status='pending',courier=NULL,assigned_sim=NULL,route=NULL,"
                "route_m=0,cost_eur=0,version=version+1 WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                (event.run_id, order["id"]),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE couriers SET status='idle' WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                (event.run_id, courier),
            )
            publish(
                conn,
                run_id=event.run_id,
                producer="courier",
                topic="courier.available",
                payload={"courier_id": courier, "order_id": order["id"]},
                key=f"assignment-cancelled:{event.id}",
                trace_id=event.trace_id,
                parent_id=event.id,
                due_sim=order["sim_time"],
            )
            courier_trace(
                conn,
                str(event.run_id),
                order["sim_time"],
                "courier",
                "assignment_cancelled",
                {"reason": "delayed handoff exceeds shift/run horizon", "distance_m": 0},
                order["id"],
                courier,
                event.id,
            )
            return
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE orders SET route=%s WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
            (Jsonb(route), event.run_id, order["id"]),
        )
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE couriers SET status='to_pickup' WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
            (event.run_id, courier),
        )
        courier_trace(
            conn,
            str(event.run_id),
            order["sim_time"],
            "courier",
            "accepted_route",
            {
                "rule": "follow approved road route; depart after acceptance; wait for preparation",
                "departure_sim": route.get("start_at", route["points"][0][2]),
                "eta_sim": route["end_at"],
            },
            event.payload["order_id"],
            courier,
            event.id,
        )

        fleet = conn.execute(
            "SELECT c.fleet_id,r.fleet_config FROM couriers c JOIN runs r ON r.id=c.run_id "
            "WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.id=%s",
            (event.run_id, courier),
        ).fetchone()
        assert fleet
        message = communication(
            fleet_contract(fleet["fleet_config"], fleet["fleet_id"]),
            courier,
            "accepted_route",
            order=order["id"],
            eta_sim=route["end_at"],
        )
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=event.run_id,
            producer="courier",
            topic="courier.accepted",
            payload={"order_id": order["id"], "courier_id": courier, "message": message},
            key=f"accepted:{event.id}",
            trace_id=order["id"],
            parent_id=event.id,
            due_sim=order["sim_time"],
        )

    def advance(self, conn: Connection, run: str, sim: int) -> None:
        relocating = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM couriers WHERE run_id=%s AND status='repositioning' FOR UPDATE",
            (run,),
        ).fetchall()
        for courier in relocating:
            route = courier["reposition_route"]
            self._travel(conn, run, courier["id"], courier["mode"], route, sim, reposition=True)
            if sim >= route["end_at"]:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE couriers SET status='idle',node=%s,reposition_route=NULL,"
                    "idle_since_sim=%s "
                    "WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                    (route["destination"], sim, run, courier["id"]),
                )
                publish(
                    conn,
                    run_id=run,
                    producer="courier",
                    topic="courier.available",
                    payload={"courier_id": courier["id"]},
                    key=f"relocated:{courier['id']}:{route['start_at']}",
                    trace_id=f"reposition:{courier['id']}:{route['start_at']}",
                    due_sim=sim,
                )
                courier_trace(
                    conn,
                    run,
                    sim,
                    "courier",
                    "repositioned",
                    {"destination": route["destination"], "distance_m": route["distance_m"]},
                    courier=courier["id"],
                )
        orders = conn.execute(
            """SELECT o.*, c.mode, c.status AS courier_status FROM orders o JOIN couriers c
               ON c.run_id=o.run_id AND c.id=o.courier
               WHERE o.run_id=%s AND o.status IN ('assigned','picked_up')
               AND c.status IN ('to_pickup','delivering') FOR UPDATE OF o,c""",
            (run,),
        ).fetchall()
        for order in orders:
            route = order["route"]
            assignment = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id FROM events WHERE run_id=%s AND topic='courier.assigned' "
                "AND trace_id=%s ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1",
                (run, order["id"]),
            ).fetchone()
            parent_id = assignment["id"] if assignment else None
            self._travel(conn, run, order["courier"], order["mode"], route, sim)
            if sim >= route["pickup_at"] and order["status"] == "assigned":
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE orders SET status='picked_up',version=version+1 "
                    "WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                    (run, order["id"]),
                )
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE couriers SET status='delivering' WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                    (run, order["courier"]),
                )
                courier_trace(
                    conn,
                    run,
                    sim,
                    "courier",
                    "picked_up",
                    {"store": order["store"]},
                    order["id"],
                    order["courier"],
                )
            if sim >= route["end_at"]:
                consumption = route["distance_m"] / 1000 * ENERGY_PER_KM[order["mode"]]
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE orders SET status='delivered',delivered_sim=%s,"
                    "version=version+1 WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s",
                    (route["end_at"], run, order["id"]),
                )
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE couriers SET status='idle',node=%s,idle_since_sim=%s,
                       completed_jobs=completed_jobs+1,operating_cost_eur=operating_cost_eur+1
                       WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s""",
                    (route["destination"], sim, run, order["courier"]),
                )
                for topic in ("order.delivered", "courier.available"):
                    publish(
                        conn,
                        run_id=run,
                        producer="courier",
                        topic=topic,
                        payload={"order_id": order["id"], "courier_id": order["courier"]},
                        key=f"{topic}:{order['id']}",
                        trace_id=order["id"],
                        due_sim=sim,
                        parent_id=parent_id,
                    )
                courier_trace(
                    conn,
                    run,
                    sim,
                    "courier",
                    "delivered",
                    {
                        "on_time": route["end_at"] <= order["due_sim"],
                        "energy_used": round(consumption, 2),
                    },
                    order["id"],
                    order["courier"],
                )
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE couriers SET status='off_shift' WHERE run_id=%s "
            "AND status='idle' AND shift_end<=%s",
            (run, sim),
        )

    @staticmethod
    def _travel(
        conn: Connection,
        run: str,
        courier: str,
        mode: str,
        route: dict[str, Any],
        sim: int,
        *,
        reposition: bool = False,
    ) -> None:
        total, empty = route_progress(route, sim)
        x, y = position(route, sim)
        # Stored cumulative leg progress makes repeated ticks/restarts idempotent.
        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE couriers SET point=ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(%s,%s),4326),
               energy=greatest(0,energy-greatest(0,%s-leg_accounted_m)*%s/1000),
               distance_m=distance_m+greatest(0,%s-leg_accounted_m),
               empty_distance_m=empty_distance_m+greatest(0,%s-leg_empty_accounted_m),
               reposition_distance_m=reposition_distance_m+CASE WHEN %s
                 THEN greatest(0,%s-leg_accounted_m) ELSE 0 END,
               operating_cost_eur=operating_cost_eur+greatest(0,%s-leg_accounted_m)*%s/1000,
               leg_accounted_m=greatest(leg_accounted_m,%s),
               leg_empty_accounted_m=greatest(leg_empty_accounted_m,%s)
               WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s""",
            (
                x,
                y,
                total,
                ENERGY_PER_KM[mode],
                total,
                empty,
                reposition,
                total,
                total,
                operating_cost(1000, mode),
                total,
                empty,
                run,
                courier,
            ),
        )


def resolve_complaint(conn: Connection, event: Event, advice: Advice, source: str) -> None:
    row = conn.execute(
        """SELECT c.*,o.due_sim,r.sim_time FROM complaints c
           JOIN orders o ON o.run_id=c.run_id AND o.id=c.order_id JOIN runs r ON r.id=c.run_id
           WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.id=%s FOR UPDATE OF c""",
        (event.run_id, event.payload["complaint_id"]),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row or row["status"] != "open":
        return
    status, refund = refund_policy(row["requested_refund_eur"], row["sim_time"] > row["due_sim"])
    if source != "llm" or advice.category == "escalate":
        status, refund = "awaiting_approval", 0
    conn.execute(
        """UPDATE complaints SET status=%s,response=%s,source=%s,approved_refund_eur=%s
           WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s""",
        (status, advice.reply, source, refund, event.run_id, row["id"]),
    )
    topic = "approval.requested" if status == "awaiting_approval" else "complaint.resolved"
    publish(
        conn,
        run_id=event.run_id,
        producer="customer_service",
        topic=topic,
        payload={"complaint_id": row["id"], "refund_eur": refund},
        key=row["id"],
        trace_id=row["order_id"],
        parent_id=event.id,
        due_sim=row["sim_time"],
        priority=10,
    )
    trace(
        conn,
        str(event.run_id),
        row["sim_time"],
        "customer_service",
        status,
        {
            "source": source,
            "category": advice.category,
            "reply": advice.reply,
            "approved_refund_eur": refund,
            "policy": "over EUR 100 requires manager approval",
        },
        row["order_id"],
        event=event.id,
    )

def tool_icon(name: str) -> str:
    if "memory" in name:
        return "memory"
    if any(word in name for word in ("read", "search", "pantry", "stock", "recipe")):
        return "search"
    if any(word in name for word in ("refund", "approve", "judge", "escalate")):
        return "shield"
    if any(word in name for word in ("contact", "offer", "message")):
        return "message"
    if any(word in name for word in ("route", "dispatch", "assign", "deliver")):
        return "route"
    if any(word in name for word in ("prep", "cook", "wait", "time")):
        return "clock"
    return "box"


def enrich_agent(agent: dict[str, Any], role: RoleSpec, release: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    name = role.role
    panels = {p["id"]: p for p in agent["panels"]}
    agent["introduction"] = f"This is the {agent['name']} agent. {INTRODUCTIONS[name]}"
    tools = [
        {
            "id": t,
            "description": role.tool_descriptions[t],
            "context": "Role tool",
            "icon": tool_icon(t),
        }
        for t in role.tools
    ]
    tools += [
        {
            "id": t,
            "description": t.replace("_", " ").capitalize(),
            "context": "Disruption recovery only",
            "icon": tool_icon(t),
        }
        for t in role.recovery_tools
    ]
    agent["tools"] = tools
    preferred = [t for t in tools if not t["id"].startswith("memory.")]
    agent["tool_badges"] = (preferred or tools)[:4]
    agent["badge"] = agent["name"]
    color, symbol, short_label = ROLE_VISUALS[name]
    agent["visual"] = {"color": color, "symbol": symbol, "label": short_label}
    # Same USD unit for every role. This is a ceiling, never a remaining balance.
    budget = float(
        panels["limits"]["numbers"].get("Default run budget (USD)", role.limits.model_usd)
    )
    agent["budget"] = {
        "value": budget,
        "unit": "USD / run",
        "label": "Default model spending cap",
        "note": "Configured limit, not money spent. Optional profiles have separate limits.",
    }
    results = panels["evals"]["results"]
    heads: dict[str, tuple[str, Any, str, list[str]]] = {
        "mission": (
            "One role, one responsibility",

"""ADK judgment behind bounded calls, durable budgets and deterministic refund policy."""

import asyncio
import json
from typing import Any, Literal

from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from delivery.config import Settings, settings
from delivery.db import connect
from delivery.queue import Event
from delivery.role_manifest import ROOT as AGENT_ROOT
from delivery.telemetry import traced_event

RESERVED_TOKENS = 3000
MAX_OUTPUT = 384
OFFLINE_MODEL = "bakiano-customer-offline-fixture-v1"
SYSTEM = (AGENT_ROOT / "customer_service/SOUL.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()


class Advice(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
    category: Literal["status", "delay", "refund", "escalate"]
    reply: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


def complaint_prompt(text: str, order_status: str) -> str:
    """Bound serialized bytes, including Unicode and JSON escapes, before token budgeting."""
    body = {"untrusted_complaint": text[:1000], "order_status": order_status[:32]}
    while True:
        prompt = json.dumps(body, ensure_ascii=False)
        if len(prompt.encode("utf-8")) <= 1024:
            return prompt
        body["untrusted_complaint"] = body["untrusted_complaint"][:-64]


def refund_policy(requested: float, overdue: bool) -> tuple[str, float]:
    if requested > 100:
        return "awaiting_approval", 0
    if requested > 0 and overdue:
        return "resolved", min(requested, 5)
    return "resolved", 0


class CustomerService:
    def __init__(self, url: str | None = None, config: Settings | None = None) -> None:
        self.url = url
        self.config = config or settings()

    def _generate(self, complaint: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[Advice, int, float]:
        from delivery.adk_customer import run_customer_advice

        return asyncio.run(run_customer_advice(self.config, complaint))

    @traced_event("agent.customer_service", agent="customer_service")
    def prepare(self, event: Event) -> tuple[Advice, str]:
        """Call outside handler transaction. A crash consumes its reservation permanently.

        Re-delivery reads cached results. An ambiguous external result never causes an
        automatic second paid request. No exactly-once claim is made for external APIs.
        """
        fallback = Advice(
            category="escalate", reply="Your request is queued for an operator review."
        )
        config = self.config
        with connect(self.url) as conn:
            complaint = conn.execute(
                """SELECT c.*, o.status AS order_status FROM complaints c JOIN orders o
                   ON o.run_id=c.run_id AND o.id=c.order_id WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.id=%s""",
                (event.run_id, event.payload["complaint_id"]),
            ).fetchone()
            if not complaint:
                return fallback, "missing_complaint"
            conn.execute("SELECT id FROM runs WHERE id=%s FOR UPDATE", (event.run_id,))
            prior = conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM llm_requests WHERE event_id=%s", (event.id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if prior:
                return (
                    Advice.model_validate(prior["result"]) if prior["result"] else fallback,
                    prior["source"],
                )
            reserve_usd = (
                RESERVED_TOKENS
                * max(config.llm_input_usd_per_million, config.llm_output_usd_per_million)
                / 1_000_000
            )
            if config.llm_provider == "offline":
                reserve_usd = 0.0
            if config.llm_provider == "disabled":
                return fallback, "disabled"
            allowed = conn.execute(
                """UPDATE runs SET llm_calls=llm_calls+1,
                   llm_reserved_tokens=llm_reserved_tokens+%s, llm_reserved_usd=llm_reserved_usd+%s
                   WHERE id=%s AND llm_calls<%s AND llm_reserved_tokens+%s<=%s
                   AND llm_reserved_usd+%s<=%s RETURNING id""",
                (
                    RESERVED_TOKENS,
                    reserve_usd,
                    event.run_id,
                    config.llm_max_calls,
                    RESERVED_TOKENS,
                    config.llm_max_tokens,
                    reserve_usd,
                    config.llm_budget_usd,
                ),
            ).fetchone()
            if not allowed:
                return fallback, "budget_exhausted"
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO llm_requests(event_id,run_id,model) VALUES (%s,%s,%s)",
                (
                    event.id,
                    event.run_id,
                    OFFLINE_MODEL if config.llm_provider == "offline" else config.llm_model,
                ),
            )
        try:
            advice, tokens, cost = self._generate(complaint)
            source = "adk_offline" if config.llm_provider == "offline" else "llm"
        except Exception as exc:
            advice, tokens, cost = fallback, 0, 0.0
            source = f"provider_error:{type(exc).__name__}"
        with connect(self.url) as conn:
            conn.execute(
                """UPDATE llm_requests SET source=%s,result=%s,tokens=%s,estimated_usd=%s
                   WHERE event_id=%s""",
                (source, Jsonb(advice.model_dump()), tokens, cost, event.id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE runs SET llm_tokens=llm_tokens+%s,llm_cost_usd=llm_cost_usd+%s WHERE id=%s",
                (tokens, cost, event.run_id),
            )
        return advice, source

"""Dark-store physics. Movement and availability, with no recovery decisions."""

from typing import Any

from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from delivery.db import Connection
from delivery.environment import RunEnvironment
from delivery.queue import publish
from delivery.store_conditions import conditions
from delivery.telemetry import trace_span


def worker_position(worker: dict[str, Any], layout: dict[str, Any], sim: int) -> list[float]:
    route = worker.get("route")
    if not route:
        return list(layout["nodes"][worker["node"]])
    points = route["points"]
    for left, right in zip(points, points[1:], strict=False):
        if sim <= right[2]:
            ratio = max(0, min(1, (sim - left[2]) / max(0.001, right[2] - left[2])))
            return [left[i] + ratio * (right[i] - left[i]) for i in (0, 1)]
    return list(points[-1][:2])


class DarkStore(RunEnvironment):
    name = "dark_store"

    def read(self, conn: Connection, run: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        sim = self.clock(conn, run)
        stores = list(
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT e.store,e.layout,e.catalogue,l.name,l.district,ST_X(l.point) lon,"
                "ST_Y(l.point) lat FROM store_environments e JOIN locations l ON l.id=e.store "
                "WHERE e.run_id=%s ORDER BY e.store",
                (run,),
            )
        )
        for store in stores:
            key, layout = store["store"], store["layout"]
            store["conditions"] = conditions(conn, run, key, layout)
            store["stock"] = list(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT sku,on_hand,reserved,on_hand-reserved "
                    "available FROM lab_stock WHERE run_id=%s "
                    "AND store=%s ORDER BY sku",
                    (run, key),
                )
            )
            store["shelves"] = list(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT slot,sku,quantity FROM store_shelves "
                    "WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s ORDER BY slot",
                    (run, key),
                )
            )
            store["workers"] = list(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT id,kind,node,route,task,available,revision "
                    "FROM store_workers WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s "
                    "ORDER BY id",
                    (run, key),
                )
            )
            for worker in store["workers"]:
                worker["position"] = worker_position(worker, layout, sim)
            store["orders"] = list(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT s.order_id,s.stage,s.lines,s.picked,s.worker,s.revision,s.packed_sim,"
                    "s.dock_sim,o.status,o.courier,o.due_sim,o.delivered_sim,o.route,"
                    "(SELECT jsonb_build_object('action',d.action,'reason',d.detail->>'reason',"
                    "'sim_time',d.sim_time) FROM decisions d WHERE d.run_id=s.run_id "
                    "AND d.order_id=s.order_id AND d.agent='fulfillment' "
                    "ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS decision "
                    "FROM store_orders s JOIN orders o ON o.run_id=s.run_id AND o.id=s.order_id "
                    "WHERE s.run_id=%s AND s.store=%s ORDER BY o.created_sim,s.order_id",
                    (run, key),
                )
            )
            store["load"] = sum(
                o["stage"] not in {"handed_off", "cancelled"} for o in store["orders"]
            )
        return {"environment": self.name, "sim_time": sim, "stores": stores}

    def advance(self, conn: Connection, run: str, sim: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self.clock(conn, run) != sim:
            raise ValueError("Store and city must use the same clock")
        environments = list(
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM store_environments WHERE run_id=%s ORDER BY store FOR UPDATE", (run,)
            )
        )
        for environment in environments:
            if environment["last_sim"] >= sim:
                continue
            store, layout = environment["store"], environment["layout"]
            state = conditions(conn, run, store, layout)
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE store_workers SET available=NOT(id=ANY(%s)) WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s",
                (state["broken"], run, store),
            )
            workers = list(
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM store_workers WHERE run_id=%s "
                    "AND store=%s ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE",
                    (run, store),
                )
            )
            for worker in workers:
                if not worker["route"]:
                    continue
                route, task = worker["route"], worker["task"]
                remaining = [
                    n
                    for n, p in zip(route["nodes"], route["points"], strict=True)
                    if p[2] > environment["last_sim"]
                ]
                interrupted = not worker["available"] or set(remaining).intersection(
                    state["blocked"]
                )
                if interrupted:
                    # Stop at the last safe grid node. A new route is an agent decision.
                    location = worker["node"]
                    for node, point in zip(route["nodes"], route["points"], strict=True):
                        if point[2] > sim or (
                            point[2] > environment["last_sim"] and node in state["blocked"]
                        ):
                            break
                        location = node
                    conn.execute(
                        "UPDATE store_workers SET node=%s,route=NULL,task=NULL "
                        "WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s AND id=%s",
                        (location, run, store, worker["id"]),
                    )
                elif route["end_sim"] <= sim:
                    publish(
                        conn,
                        run_id=run,
                        producer="store_world",
                        topic="store.worker.arrived",
                        payload={"order_id": task["order_id"], "worker": worker["id"]},
                        key=f"{store}:{worker['id']}:{worker['revision']}",
                        trace_id=task["order_id"],
                        due_sim=sim,
                        target_store=store,
                    )
            # Only physically arrived supply creates an inventory-agent receipt event.
            shipments = conn.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM lab_shipments WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s "
                "AND status!='received' AND expected_sim<=%s ORDER BY id",
                (run, store, sim),
            ).fetchall()
            for shipment in shipments:
                publish(
                    conn,
                    run_id=run,
                    producer="store_world",
                    topic="store.restock.arrived",
                    payload={"order_id": "_stock", "shipment": shipment["id"]},
                    key=shipment["id"],
                    trace_id=shipment["id"],
                    due_sim=sim,
                    target_store=store,
                )
            orders = conn.execute(
                "SELECT s.order_id,s.stage,o.status FROM store_orders s JOIN orders o "
                "ON o.run_id=s.run_id AND o.id=s.order_id WHERE s.run_id=%s "
                "AND s.store=%s AND s.stage NOT IN ('cancelled','handed_off') "
                "ORDER BY s.order_id",
                (run, store),
            ).fetchall()
            for order in orders:
                if order["status"] in {"picked_up", "delivered"}:
                    conn.execute(
                        "UPDATE store_orders SET stage='handed_off' WHERE run_id=%s "
                        "AND order_id=%s",
                        (run, order["order_id"]),
                    )
                    publish(
                        conn,
                        run_id=run,
                        producer="store_world",
                        topic="store.courier.collected",
                        payload={"order_id": order["order_id"]},
                        key=order["order_id"],
                        trace_id=order["order_id"],
                        due_sim=sim,
                        target_store=store,
                    )
                elif order["status"] == "unserved":
                    from delivery.store_agents import cancel_order

                    stored = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT * FROM store_orders WHERE run_id=%s AND order_id=%s",
                        (run, order["order_id"]),
                    ).fetchone()
                    assert stored
                    cancel_order(conn, run, stored, sim)
                else:
                    busy = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT 1 FROM store_workers WHERE run_id=%s "
                        "AND store=%s AND task->>'order_id'=%s AND available",
                        (run, store, order["order_id"]),
                    ).fetchone()
                    # An unfinished route needs no policy turn on every physical tick.
                    if not busy and order["stage"] != "dock" and (sim % 60 == 0 or sim < 600):
                        self.wake(conn, run, store, order["order_id"], sim)
            forklift = conn.execute(
                "SELECT task FROM store_workers WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s AND kind='forklift'",
                (run, store),
            ).fetchone()
            backstock = conn.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM store_shelves WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s "
                "AND slot LIKE 'backstock:%%' AND quantity>0",
                (run, store),
            ).fetchone()
            if backstock and forklift and not forklift["task"] and sim % 60 == 0:
                self.wake(conn, run, store, "_stock", sim)
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE store_environments SET last_sim=%s WHERE run_id=%s AND store=%s",
                (sim, run, store),
            )
        with trace_span(
            "environment.advance",
            attributes={"delivery.environment": self.name, "delivery.sim_time": sim},
        ):
            pass
        return {"environment": self.name, "sim_time": sim, "stores": len(environments)}

    @staticmethod
    def wake(conn: Connection, run: str, store: str, order: str, sim: int) -> None:
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run,
            producer="store_world",
            topic="store.replan",
            payload={"order_id": order},
            key=f"{store}:{order}:{sim}",
            trace_id=order,
            due_sim=sim,
            target_store=store,
        )

    def record(self, conn: Connection, run: str) -> None:
        state = self.read(conn, run)
        for store in state["stores"]:
            store.pop("layout")
            store.pop("catalogue")
            for order in store["orders"]:
                order.pop("route")
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO store_frames(run_id,sim,state) VALUES (%s,%s,%s) "
            "ON CONFLICT(run_id,sim) DO NOTHING",
            (run, state["sim_time"], Jsonb(state)),
        )

"""Frozen, inspectable dispatch economics; no model or external service access."""

import hashlib
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from delivery.dispatch_optimizer import Candidate
from delivery.world import COST_PER_KM


class DispatchPolicy(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True, allow_inf_nan=False)

    strategy: Literal["min_cost", "legacy"] = "min_cost"
    reposition: Literal["stay", "demand_aware"] = "stay"
    initial_positions: Literal["distributed", "hubs"] = "distributed"
    time_value_eur_per_hour: float = Field(default=12, ge=1, le=100)
    late_weight: float = Field(default=20, ge=1, le=100)
    empty_time_weight: float = Field(default=1, ge=0, le=10)
    demand_window_seconds: int = Field(default=1800, ge=300, le=7200)
    reposition_max_m: int = Field(default=1500, ge=100, le=3000)
    reposition_cooldown_seconds: int = Field(default=900, ge=300, le=3600)
    reposition_min_saving_seconds: int = Field(default=120, ge=30, le=900)


def load_policy(config: dict[str, Any]) -> DispatchPolicy:
    # Historical runs with no frozen config retain their original policy.
    return DispatchPolicy.model_validate(
        config or {"strategy": "legacy", "initial_positions": "hubs"}
    )


def operating_cost(distance_m: float, mode: str, *, job: bool = False) -> float:
    """Synthetic marginal vehicle cost plus the existing €1 task fee."""
    return float(job) + distance_m / 1000 * COST_PER_KM[mode]


def assignment_score(
    route: dict[str, Any], mode: str, sim: int, due: int, policy: DispatchPolicy
) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Generalized seconds: service duration, lateness, empty time and money.

    Prep wait can equalize completion ETAs; explicit empty driving and money
    still distinguish couriers. The fixed task fee is excluded from ranking.
    """
    components = {
        "completion_seconds": max(0, route["end_at"] - sim),
        "late_penalty_seconds": max(0, route["end_at"] - due) * policy.late_weight,
        "empty_penalty_seconds": route["pickup_travel_seconds"] * policy.empty_time_weight,
        "vehicle_cost_seconds": operating_cost(route["distance_m"], mode)
        * 3600
        / policy.time_value_eur_per_hour,
    }
    return {**components, "total": sum(components.values())}


def fair_ranks(couriers: list[dict[str, Any]], salt: str) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Longest idle, then fewer jobs, then a reproducible non-lexical lottery."""
    ordered = sorted(
        couriers,
        key=lambda c: (
            c["idle_since_sim"],
            c["completed_jobs"],
            hashlib.sha256(f"{salt}:{c['id']}".encode()).digest(),
        ),
    )
    return {c["id"]: rank for rank, c in enumerate(ordered)}


def prioritize_deadlines(candidates: list[Candidate], order_ids: list[str]) -> list[Candidate]:
    """After maximum cardinality, serve earliest deadlines before comparing cost.

    Charging lateness only to selected jobs would make an already-late job ever
    more expensive and starve it. Binary ranks encode lexicographic service
    priority for the bounded batch. A unit dominates all possible economic costs;
    within the same served order set the economic objective is unchanged.
    """
    if not candidates:
        return []
    ranks = {order: i for i, order in enumerate(order_ids)}
    count = len(ranks)
    cardinality = min(count, len({c.courier_id for c in candidates}))
    scale = cardinality * max(c.cost for c in candidates) + 1
    return [
        Candidate(
            c.order_id,
            c.courier_id,
            c.cost + ((1 << count) - (1 << (count - ranks[c.order_id] - 1))) * scale,
            c.tie_break_rank,
        )
        for c in candidates
    ]

"""Conservative observed-demand relocation, with queue handoff and real travel.

This is a transparent heuristic, not a learned demand forecast. No future orders
are read. A move must improve fleet-wide pickup coverage enough to pay for itself.
"""

from typing import Any

import networkx as nx
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from delivery.contractors import fleet_contract
from delivery.db import Connection
from delivery.dispatch_policy import DispatchPolicy, operating_cost
from delivery.queue import Event, publish
from delivery.world import ENERGY_PER_KM, SPEED_MPS, World, trace


def relocation_choice(
    world: World,
    courier: dict[str, Any],
    fleet: list[dict[str, Any]],
    demand: list[dict[str, Any]],
    sim: int,
    duration: int,
    policy: DispatchPolicy,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], float] | None:
    if sim - courier["last_reposition_sim"] < policy.reposition_cooldown_seconds:
        return None
    if not demand:
        return None

    def pickup_seconds(node: int, store: int, mode: str) -> float:
        try:
            return world.path(node, store)[1] / SPEED_MPS[mode]
        except (nx.NetworkXNoPath, nx.NodeNotFound):
            return 7200.0

    def coverage(moved_to: int | None = None) -> float:
        # Expected next 15 minutes, bounded to three orders per observed store.
        return sum(
            min(3.0, d["orders"] * 900 / policy.demand_window_seconds)
            * min(
                (
                    pickup_seconds(
                        moved_to
                        if c["id"] == courier["id"] and moved_to is not None
                        else c["node"],
                        d["node"],
                        c["mode"],
                    )
                    for c in fleet
                    if not c.get("service_district") or c["service_district"] == d.get("district")
                ),
                default=7200.0,
            )
            for d in demand
        )

    before = coverage()
    best: tuple[dict[str, Any], float] | None = None
    for store in sorted(demand, key=lambda d: d["store"]):
        if courier.get("service_district") and courier["service_district"] != store.get("district"):
            continue
        if store["orders"] < 2 or store["node"] == courier["node"]:
            continue
        try:
            route = world.relocation(courier["node"], store["node"], courier["mode"], sim)
        except (nx.NetworkXNoPath, nx.NodeNotFound):
            continue
        if route["distance_m"] > policy.reposition_max_m:
            continue
        if route["end_at"] + 600 > min(duration, courier["shift_end"]):
            continue
        if courier["energy"] - route["distance_m"] / 1000 * ENERGY_PER_KM[courier["mode"]] < 10:
            continue
        expense = (
            route["pickup_travel_seconds"]
            + operating_cost(route["distance_m"], courier["mode"])
            * 3600
            / policy.time_value_eur_per_hour
        )
        saving = before - coverage(store["node"]) - expense
        if saving >= policy.reposition_min_saving_seconds and (best is None or saving > best[1]):
            best = route, saving
    return best


def reposition_idle(
    conn: Connection, event: Event, world: World, run: dict[str, Any], policy: DispatchPolicy
) -> None:
    sim = run["sim_time"]
    demand = conn.execute(
        """SELECT o.store,l.node,l.district,count(*) AS orders FROM orders o
           JOIN locations l ON l.id=o.store WHERE o.run_id=%s
           AND o.created_sim BETWEEN %s AND %s GROUP BY o.store,l.node,l.district""",
        (event.run_id, max(0, sim - policy.demand_window_seconds), sim),
    ).fetchall()
    idle = conn.execute(
        """SELECT c.*,h.district AS home_district FROM couriers c
           JOIN locations h ON h.id=c.hub WHERE c.run_id=%s AND c.status='idle' AND c.energy>10
           AND c.shift_end>%s ORDER BY c.idle_since_sim,c.completed_jobs,c.id
           FOR UPDATE OF c SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100""",
        (event.run_id, sim),
    ).fetchall()
    moving = conn.execute(
        "SELECT c.id,c.mode,c.reposition_route,c.fleet_id,h.district AS home_district "
        "FROM couriers c JOIN locations h ON h.id=c.hub WHERE c.run_id=%s "
        "AND c.status IN ('repositioning','reposition_reserved')",
        (event.run_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    for c in idle + moving:
        contract = fleet_contract(run["fleet_config"], c["fleet_id"])
        c["service_district"] = (
            c["home_district"] if contract["coverage"] == "home_district" else None
        )
    fleet = [dict(c) for c in idle] + [
        {
            "id": c["id"],
            "mode": c["mode"],
            "node": c["reposition_route"]["destination"],
            "service_district": c["service_district"],
        }
        for c in moving
    ]
    # A maximum of two moves per event; reserved destinations cover subsequent choices.
    moves = 0
    for courier in idle:
        choice = relocation_choice(world, courier, fleet, demand, sim, run["duration"], policy)
        if not choice:
            continue
        route, saving = choice
        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE couriers SET status='reposition_reserved',reposition_route=%s,
               last_reposition_sim=%s,leg_accounted_m=0,leg_empty_accounted_m=0
               WHERE run_id=%s AND id=%s""",
            (Jsonb(route), sim, event.run_id, courier["id"]),
        )
        for c in fleet:
            if c["id"] == courier["id"]:
                c["node"] = route["destination"]
        key = f"reposition:{courier['id']}:{sim}"
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=event.run_id,
            producer="dispatcher",
            topic="courier.reposition",
            payload={"courier_id": courier["id"]},
            key=key,
            trace_id=key,
            parent_id=event.id,
            due_sim=sim,
        )
        trace(
            conn,
            str(event.run_id),
            sim,
            "dispatcher",
            "reposition_requested",
            {
                "rule": "observed coverage benefit exceeds empty-trip expense and hysteresis",
                "history_window_seconds": policy.demand_window_seconds,
                "start_node": courier["node"],
                "destination": route["destination"],
                "distance_m": route["distance_m"],
                "net_saving_seconds": round(saving, 2),
            },
            courier=courier["id"],
            event=event.id,
        )
        moves += 1
        if moves == 2:
            break
src/delivery/durable_inference.py:
"""Durable, single-dispatch optional judgement outside worker DB connections.

A dispatch marker consumes the bounded allowance before provider I/O. If its
outcome cannot be known, a subsequent lease fails closed and never resends it.
This deliberately does not claim exactly-once provider execution or billing.
"""

from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any

from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from delivery.cloud_ai import CloudJudge, Judgment, sanitized_request
from delivery.db import connect
from delivery.queue import Event
from delivery.telemetry import traced_event

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from delivery.agent_runtime import LocalAgent

Fault = Callable[[str], None] | None


def checkpoint(fault: Fault, stage: str) -> None:
    if fault is not None:
        fault(stage)


def local_proposal(context: dict[str, Any], sim: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The model may only veto this locally computed, numeric route summary."""
    from delivery.workflow_policy import route_plan

    try:
        courier, route = route_plan(context)
    except ValueError:
        return {"courier": None, "route": None, "candidate": None}
    edges = {(e["from"], e["to"]): e["travel_seconds"] for e in context["roads"]["edges"]}
    candidate = {
        "estimated_seconds": sum(edges[a, b] for a, b in zip(route, route[1:], strict=False)),
        "remaining_seconds": max(0, context["job"]["deadline_sim"] - sim),
        "route_nodes": len(route),
    }
    return {"courier": courier, "route": route, "candidate": candidate}


def prepare(agent: "LocalAgent", event: Event) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Commit a server-scoped observation and sealed request in one short tx."""
    if agent.role.name != "judge" or agent.role.policy != "gcp_ai" or not agent.cloud_endpoint:
        raise PermissionError("Configured cloud judge required")
    with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT public.agent_inference_begin(%s,%s,%s,%s) AS request",
            (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, agent.cloud_endpoint),
        ).fetchone()
        assert row
        request = dict(row["request"])
        if request["state"] == "preparing":
            proposal = local_proposal(request["context"], request["sim_time"])
            outbound = sanitized_request(
                {"job": {**request["context"]["job"], "sim_time": request["sim_time"]}},
                request["memory"],
                candidate=proposal["candidate"],
            )
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT public.agent_inference_seal(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) AS request",
                (
                    event.id,
                    event.token,
                    event.attempts,
                    request["id"],
                    Jsonb(proposal),
                    Jsonb(outbound),
                ),
            ).fetchone()
            assert row
            request = dict(row["request"])
    return request


@traced_event("agent.judge.inference")
def ensure_result(agent: "LocalAgent", event: Event, *, fault: Fault = None) -> bool:
    """Prepare/dispatch/save, returning False only when another owner is busy/stale.

    Each connection context has exited before a hook adjacent to I/O or the
    provider itself runs. There are no automatic provider retries, including
    malformed responses, timeouts, and a process lost after dispatch commit.
    """
    request = prepare(agent, event)
    checkpoint(fault, "after_prepare")
    if request["state"] == "in_flight":
        return False
    if request["state"] == "prepared":
        with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT public.agent_inference_dispatch(%s,%s,%s,%s) AS dispatch",
                (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, request["id"]),
            ).fetchone()
            assert row
            dispatch = row["dispatch"]
            request = dispatch["request"]
        if not dispatch["dispatch"]:
            return request["state"] in {"succeeded", "failed", "unknown"}
        checkpoint(fault, "after_dispatch")
        checkpoint(fault, "before_invoke")
        outcome: dict[str, Any] | None = None
        error: str | None = None
        try:
            # Even the transport adapter receives only numeric facts and a count;
            # scoped context, memory bodies, route/courier IDs stay in PostgreSQL.
            outbound = request["sanitized_request"]
            raw = CloudJudge(request["endpoint"]).review(
                {"job": outbound["facts"]},
                [None] * outbound["memory_entries"],
                candidate=outbound["candidate"],
            )
            result = Judgment.model_validate(raw.model_dump())
            if outbound["candidate"] is None and result.decision == "approve_retry":
                raise ValueError("Cannot approve without a local route proposal")
            outcome = result.model_dump()
        except Exception as exc:
            # Exception text may include response bodies or authentication data.
            error = type(exc).__name__
        checkpoint(fault, "after_response")
        checkpoint(fault, "before_result_save")
        with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT public.agent_inference_save(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s) AS saved",
                (
                    event.id,
                    event.token,
                    event.attempts,
                    request["id"],
                    request["dispatch_token"],
                    Jsonb(outcome) if outcome is not None else None,
                    error,
                ),
            ).fetchone()
            assert row
            saved = bool(row["saved"])
        if not saved:
            return False
        checkpoint(fault, "after_result_save")
        return True
    return request["state"] in {"succeeded", "failed", "unknown"}


def saved_result(conn: Any, agent: "LocalAgent", event: Event) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The effect transaction can read a receipt; it has no provider capability."""
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT public.agent_inference_read(%s,%s,%s) AS request",
        (event.id, event.token, event.attempts),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        raise PermissionError("Durable inference receipt required")
    request = dict(row["request"])
    if request["endpoint"] != agent.cloud_endpoint or request["state"] not in {
        "succeeded",
        "failed",
        "unknown",
    }:
        raise PermissionError("Completed compatible inference receipt required")
    return request


def apply_receipt(conn: Any, event: Event, request: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT public.agent_inference_applied(%s,%s,%s,%s) AS applied",
        (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, request["id"]),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row or not row["applied"]:
        raise PermissionError("Inference apply lease expired")

"""Public, synthetic memory documentation built from runtime contracts.

Never reads a run, environment configuration, database or cloud service.
"""
from typing import Any

from delivery.agent_specs import RoleSpec
from delivery.memory_profiles import MemoryProfile, project_memory
from delivery.semantic_memory import DIMENSIONS, MODEL
from delivery.typed_memory import CONTRACTS, validate_fact

SOURCES = [
    "src/delivery/memory_reference.py",
    "src/delivery/typed_memory.py",
    "src/delivery/memory_profiles.py",
    "src/delivery/semantic_memory.py",
    "src/delivery/agent_runtime.py",
    "src/delivery/adk_restaurant.py",
    "sql/migrations/015_typed_memory.sql",
    "sql/migrations/024_agent_memory_modes.sql",
    "sql/migrations/031_semantic_memory.sql",
    "infra/production/live.tf",
    "infra/production/vector.tf",
    "tests/test_semantic_memory.py",
    "evals/memory/recall.json",
]
SAMPLES: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "inventory.reservation": {"status": "reserved"},
    "inventory.shipment": {"status": "delayed", "expected_sim": 900},
    "fulfillment.progress": {"status": "picked"},
    "delivery.progress": {"status": "assigned", "attempt": 1, "courier": "demo-courier"},
    "courier.commitment": {"status": "accepted", "attempt": 1},
    "recovery.verdict": {"verdict": "approved", "attempt": 1,
                         "reason": "A replacement can arrive before the deadline.",
                         "remaining_seconds": 600},
    "household.order": {"status": "calling", "action": "calling"},
    "restaurant.order": {"status": "cooking", "action": "ingredient_received"},
    "market.request": {"ingredient": "tomato", "quantity": 500.0, "unit": "g",
                       "outcome": "supplier_reserved"},
}
PROFILE_NOTES = {
    "none": "Returns an empty list. Writes and the audit ledger still exist.",
    "text": "A bounded string with scope, facts and provenance. It is not a text file.",
    "json": "A JSON object separates shared scope, fact bodies and provenance.",
    "typed": "A list of complete typed records, including scope and provenance.",
    "semantic": "Ranks the permitted candidates by meaning, then returns typed records. "
                "This one-record example shows the shape, not a measured search result.",
}


def memory_reference(role: RoleSpec) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profile = MemoryProfile()
    schema = profile.model_json_schema()
    contracts = []
    for kind, (owner, subject, topics, body_type) in CONTRACTS.items():
        if owner != role.name:
            continue
        body = validate_fact(kind, SAMPLES[kind], owner, topics[0])
        context_type = "shipment" if subject == "shipment" else "order"
        context_id = "demo-shipment" if subject == "shipment" else "demo-order"
        record = {
            "fact_id": 42, "run_id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001",
            "store": "demo-store", "owner_role": owner,
            "context_type": context_type, "context_id": context_id,
            "kind": kind, "subject": "demo-request" if subject == "request" else context_id,
            "version": 1, "body": body, "observed_sim": 120,
            "expires_sim": 120 + profile.ttl_seconds, "event_id": 17, "previous_id": None,
        }
        contracts.append({
            "kind": kind, "topics": list(topics), "subject": subject,
            "body_schema": body_type.model_json_schema(), "record": record,
            "projections": {
                mode: project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode=mode), [record])
                for mode in schema["properties"]["mode"]["enum"]
            },
        })
    return {
        "persistent": bool(contracts),
        "applicability": (
            "The scoped worker writes these observations. Restaurant ADK recall passes "
            "the selected projection into its tool response. Deterministic workers keep "
            "canonical facts for decisions and audit; a memory profile does not add a model."
            if contracts else
            "This complaint classifier has no persistent memory contract or memory tools. "
            "Its ADK session is created per complaint. Request/result receipts prevent "
            "repeat billing, but are not semantic recall. Chaos turns receive only the "
            "affected order facts."
        ),
        "format": "PostgreSQL rows with a JSONB body",
        "format_note": "This is not a CSV, chat transcript or file per agent. A typed "
                       "observation records what happened; order and stock tables still "
                       "decide what is true now.",
        "contracts": contracts,
        "profile_defaults": profile.model_dump(),
        "profile_schema": schema,
        "profile_notes": PROFILE_NOTES,
        "manifest_profile": role.memory.model_dump() if role.memory else None,
        "capacity": {
            "memory_entries": role.limits.memory_entries,
            "memory_bytes": role.limits.memory_bytes,
            "tool_calls_per_event": role.limits.tool_calls_per_event,
        },
        "fields": [
            {"title": "Scope", "keys": ["run_id", "store", "owner_role", "context_type",
                                      "context_id", "subject"],
             "note": "SQL derives these from the authenticated role and its leased event. "
                     "The agent cannot choose another order or namespace."},
            {"title": "Observation", "keys": ["kind", "body"],
             "note": "A role-specific schema validates the body in Python and SQL. "
                     "Unknown fields are rejected; observations grant no authority."},
            {"title": "History", "keys": ["fact_id", "version", "event_id", "observed_sim",
                                        "expires_sim", "previous_id"],
             "note": "The database assigns identity, provenance and revision. Times are "
                     "simulation seconds, not wall-clock timestamps. fact_id is the "
