def test_relocation_uses_observed_demand_and_waits_for_handoff_before_charging(
    db_url: str, run_id: UUID, world: World, places: dict[str, Any]
) -> None:
    sim = 1000
    pickup = places["store"]["node"]
    start = nearby_reposition_start(world, pickup)
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        configure(conn, run_id, sim=sim, reposition="demand_aware")
        add_courier(conn, run_id, world, places, "bike-1", start)
        for index in range(6):
            add_order(
                conn,
                run_id,
                places,
                f"future-{index}",
                sim + 1000,
                sim + 1000,
                status="unserved",
                enqueue=False,
            )

    def pulse(key: str) -> None:
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            publish(
                conn,
                run_id=run_id,
                producer="courier",
                topic="courier.available",
                payload={"courier_id": "bike-1"},
                key=key,
                trace_id=key,
                due_sim=sim,
            )
        queue = Queue(db_url)
        event = queue.claim("dispatcher", run_id, sim, accepted_topics=("courier.available",))
        assert event and queue.process(event, Dispatcher(world).handle)

    pulse("future-only")
    assert courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")["status"] == "idle"
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        for index in range(6):
            add_order(
                conn,
                run_id,
                places,
                f"observed-{index}",
                sim - 100,
                sim - 100,
                status="unserved",
                enqueue=False,
            )
    pulse("observed")
    reserved = courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")
    assert reserved["status"] == "reposition_reserved"
    assert reserved["node"] == start and reserved["distance_m"] == 0
    assert reserved["reposition_route"]["destination"] == pickup
    acknowledged = sim + math.floor(reserved["reposition_route"]["pickup_travel_seconds"] / 2)
    advance(db_url, run_id, acknowledged)
    assert courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")["distance_m"] == 0
    accept(db_url, run_id, acknowledged, "courier.reposition")
    moving = courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")
    route = moving["reposition_route"]
    assert moving["status"] == "repositioning" and route["start_at"] == acknowledged
    advance(db_url, run_id, acknowledged)
    assert courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")["distance_m"] == 0
    partial = acknowledged + math.floor(route["pickup_travel_seconds"] / 2)
    advance(db_url, run_id, partial)
    state = courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")
    expected = (partial - acknowledged) * SPEED_MPS["bike"]
    assert state["distance_m"] == pytest.approx(expected)
    assert state["empty_distance_m"] == pytest.approx(expected)
    assert state["reposition_distance_m"] == pytest.approx(expected)
    assert state["energy"] == pytest.approx(100 - expected / 1000 * ENERGY_PER_KM["bike"])
    advance(db_url, run_id, route["end_at"])
    complete = courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1")
    assert complete["status"] == "idle" and complete["node"] == pickup
    assert complete["completed_jobs"] == 0 and complete["reposition_route"] is None
    assert complete["distance_m"] == pytest.approx(route["distance_m"])
    assert complete["empty_distance_m"] == pytest.approx(route["distance_m"])
    assert complete["reposition_distance_m"] == pytest.approx(route["distance_m"])
    assert complete["operating_cost_eur"] == pytest.approx(
        operating_cost(route["distance_m"], "bike")
    )
    advance(db_url, run_id, route["end_at"])
    assert courier_state(db_url, run_id, "bike-1") == complete
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        event = conn.execute(
            "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM events WHERE run_id=%s AND topic='courier.available' "
            "AND dedupe_key LIKE 'relocated:%%'",
            (run_id,),
        ).fetchone()
    assert event == {"n": 1}

        ("inventory", "store-1"),
        ("fulfillment", "store-1"),
        ("dispatcher", "fleet"),

    first = own.claim()
    assert first and first.payload["attempt"] == 1 and own.reserve_budget(first)
    with connect(own.dsn) as conn:
        tools = ScopedTools(conn, own.scope, own.role, first)
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            tools.invoke(
                "memory.write", kind="courier.commitment", body={"status": "accepted", "attempt": 2}

            "memory.write", kind="courier.commitment", body={"status": "accepted", "attempt": 1}
        )

    # A trusted queued rebrief addresses the same order but another attempt.

        assert ScopedTools(conn, own.scope, own.role, second).invoke("memory.read") == []
    with connect(couriers["bike-2"].dsn) as conn:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege):
            conn.execute(

    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE lab_fleet SET status='offline' WHERE run_id=%s AND id<>'bike-1'", (fleet,)
        )
        for basket in ("race-a", "race-b"):
            conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO lab_delivery_jobs(run_id,basket,store,pickup_node,customer_node)
                VALUES (%s,%s,'store-1',99,100)""",
                (fleet, basket),
            )
            publish(
                conn,
                run_id=fleet,
                producer="fulfillment",
                topic="basket.ready",
                payload={"basket": basket},
                key=basket,
                trace_id=basket,
                target_store="dispatcher:fleet",
            )
    workers = [create_agent(access.dsn), create_agent(access.dsn)]
    events = [worker.claim() for worker in workers]
    assert all(events) and events[0].id != events[1].id
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as pool:
        results = list(
            pool.map(lambda pair: pair[0].process(pair[1]), zip(workers, events, strict=True))

    assert results == [True, True]

def test_capability_selectors_resolve_to_current_test_functions():
    import ast
    from pathlib import Path

    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    manifest = json.loads((root / "config/health-categories.json").read_text())
    for capability in manifest["capabilities"]:
        for selector in capability["selectors"]:
            path, _, function = selector.partition("::")
            source = root / path
            assert source.is_file(), selector
            if function:
                names = {
                    node.name
                    for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source.read_text()))
                    if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef))
                }
                assert function in names, selector

"""Real worker death must recover durable inference without a second uncertain call."""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
from collections.abc import Iterator
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

import psycopg
import pytest
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from delivery.agent_access import retire_inventory_access, role_access
from delivery.agent_runtime import LocalAgent, create_agent
from delivery.cloud_ai import CloudJudge, Judgment
from delivery.db import connect
from delivery.delivery_flow import new_delivery
from delivery.durable_inference import prepare
from delivery.fleet_flow import advance_fleet, prepare_fleet

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration

ENDPOINT = "https://judge.run.app"
WORKER = """
import os
from delivery.agent_runtime import create_agent
from delivery.cloud_ai import CloudJudge, Judgment

def fake_review(self, context, memory, *, candidate):
    descriptor = os.open(os.environ['FAKE_CALLS'], os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
    try:
        os.write(descriptor, b'invoked\\n')
        os.fsync(descriptor)
    finally:
        os.close(descriptor)
    return Judgment(decision='approve_retry', reason='Local fake provider', model='fake-local',
                    input_tokens=5, output_tokens=3)

def fault(stage):
    if stage == os.environ['CRASH_STAGE']:
        os._exit(73)

CloudJudge.review = fake_review
agent = create_agent(os.environ['DATABASE_URL'], agent_mode='gcp_ai',
                     cloud_endpoint='https://judge.run.app')
event = agent.claim(lease_seconds=30)
assert event is not None
agent.process(event, fault=fault)
raise RuntimeError('Crash checkpoint not reached')
"""


@pytest.fixture
def failed_delivery(db_url: str) -> Iterator[tuple[str, LocalAgent]]:
    run = new_delivery(url=db_url)
    try:
        prepare_fleet(run, db_url)
        for role, key in (
            ("inventory", "store-1"),
            ("fulfillment", "store-1"),
            ("dispatcher", "fleet"),
            ("courier", "bike-1"),
        ):
            agent = create_agent(role_access(run, role, db_url)[key].dsn)
            event = agent.claim()
            assert event and agent.process(event)
        advance_fleet(run, 180, db_url)
        access = role_access(run, "judge", db_url, agent_mode="gcp_ai")["fleet"]
        yield run, create_agent(access.dsn, agent_mode="gcp_ai", cloud_endpoint=ENDPOINT)
    finally:
        retire_inventory_access(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM decisions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (run,))


def fake_provider(monkeypatch, path: Path) -> None:
    def review(self, context, memory, *, candidate):
        with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write("invoked\n")
        return Judgment(
            decision="approve_retry",
            reason="Local fake provider",
            model="fake-local",
            input_tokens=5,
            output_tokens=3,
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(CloudJudge, "review", review)


def call_count(path: Path) -> int:
    return len(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()) if path.exists() else 0


def test_inference_capabilities_deny_other_roles_runs_and_unleased_sources(db_url, failed_delivery):
    run, agent = failed_delivery
    event = agent.claim()
    assert event and agent.reserve_budget(event)
    prepare(agent, event)
    for role, key in (
        ("inventory", "store-1"),
        ("fulfillment", "store-1"),
        ("dispatcher", "fleet"),
        ("courier", "bike-1"),
    ):
        access = role_access(run, role, db_url)[key]
        with connect(access.dsn) as conn:
            for statement, parameters in (
                ("SELECT agent_inference_read(%s,%s,%s)", (event.id, event.token, event.attempts)),
                ("SELECT * FROM agent_inference_requests", ()),
                ("UPDATE agent_inference_requests SET state='succeeded'", ()),
            ):
                with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                    conn.execute(statement, parameters)
    other_run = new_delivery(url=db_url)
    try:
        foreign = role_access(other_run, "judge", db_url, agent_mode="gcp_ai")["fleet"]
        with connect(foreign.dsn) as conn:
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege):
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT agent_inference_read(%s,%s,%s)", (event.id, event.token, event.attempts)
                )
        with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT agent_inference_scope(%s,%s,%s)",
                    (event.id, event.token, event.attempts),
                )
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT agent_inference_read(%s,gen_random_uuid(),%s)",
                    (event.id, event.attempts),
                )
    finally:
        retire_inventory_access(other_run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE run_id=%s", (other_run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (other_run,))


def dispatch_request(agent, event):
    assert agent.reserve_budget(event)
    request = prepare(agent, event)
    with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
        response = conn.execute(
            "SELECT agent_inference_dispatch(%s,%s,%s,%s) AS result",
            (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, request["id"]),
        ).fetchone()["result"]
    assert response["dispatch"]
    return response["request"]


def test_competing_worker_on_same_live_lease_leaves_original_owner_intact(
    db_url, failed_delivery, monkeypatch
):
    run, agent = failed_delivery
    event = agent.claim()
    assert event
    invocations = []
    competing = []

    def review(self, context, memory, *, candidate):
        invocations.append(True)
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
            competing.append(pool.submit(agent.process, event).result(timeout=8))
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            live = conn.execute(
                "SELECT state,lease_token FROM events WHERE id=%s", (event.id,)
            ).fetchone()
            assert live["state"] == "leased" and live["lease_token"] == event.token
        return Judgment(
            decision="approve_retry",
            reason="Original worker owns dispatch",
            model="fake-local",
            input_tokens=5,
            output_tokens=3,
        )

    monkeypatch.setattr(CloudJudge, "review", review)
    assert agent.process(event)
    assert competing == [False] and invocations == [True]
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) AS n FROM agent_model_calls WHERE run_id=%s", (run,)
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 1
        )


def test_old_owner_cannot_overwrite_after_a_new_lease_applies(db_url, failed_delivery, monkeypatch):
    run, agent = failed_delivery
    old = agent.claim()
    assert old
    request = dispatch_request(agent, old)
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE events SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=%s",
            (old.id,),
        )
    current = agent.claim()
    assert current and current.attempts == 2
    monkeypatch.setattr(CloudJudge, "review", lambda *a, **k: pytest.fail("Uncertain call resent"))
    assert agent.process(current)
    outcome = Judgment(
        decision="approve_retry",
        reason="Late old response",
        model="fake-local",
        input_tokens=5,
        output_tokens=3,
    ).model_dump()
    with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT agent_inference_save(%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,%s,NULL)",
                (
                    old.id,
                    old.token,
                    old.attempts,
                    request["id"],
                    request["dispatch_token"],
                    Jsonb(outcome),
                ),
            )
    with connect(db_url) as conn:

def answered(request, executor="direct", action="source", supplier="market-a", sure=1.0):
    values = {"executor": executor, "action": action, "supplier": supplier}
    answers = {}
    for name, question in request["questions"].items():
        options = list(question["criteria"])
        choice = values[name]
        other = (1 - sure) / (len(options) - 1) if len(options) > 1 else 0
        answers[name] = {
            "type": "choice",
            "choice": choice,
            "confidence": sure,
            "probabilities": {k: sure if k == choice else other for k in options},
        }
    return {
        "model": request["model"],
        "answers": answers,
        "usage": {"input_tokens": 300, "output_tokens": 50},
    }


def routed_city(factory, **routing):
    return factory(brain_changes={"routing": JevRouting(**routing).model_dump()})

def test_completed_bad_proposal_can_be_corrected_without_restaging(adk_city, failure):
    from delivery.adk_offline import OfflineRestaurantModel

    class CorrectingModel(OfflineRestaurantModel):
        broken: bool = False

        async def generate_content_async(self, llm_request, stream=False):
            last = llm_request.contents[-1]
            if any(
                part.function_response
                and part.function_response.response.get("error") == "tool_contract"
                for part in last.parts or []
            ):
                yield self.response(
                    calls=[
                        (
                            "finish_decision",
                            {"summary": "Selected the scoped supplier following the SOUL."},
                        )
                    ]
                )
                return
            async for response in super().generate_content_async(llm_request, stream):
                for part in response.content.parts or []:
                    if (
                        not self.broken
                        and part.function_call
                        and part.function_call.name == "finish_decision"
                    ):
                        self.broken = True
                        if failure == "unknown_tool":
                            part.function_call.name = "finish_finish_decision"
                        else:
                            part.function_call.args["summary"] = "x" * 574
                yield response

    city = adk_city(brain_changes={"model_calls_per_event": 8})
    agent, event = first_call(city)
    assert agent.reserve_budget(event)
    assert ensure_restaurant_result(agent, event, model=CorrectingModel())
    with connect(city.url) as conn:

            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 0

            (event.id,),
        ).fetchall()
        assert sum(r["tool"] == "restaurant.request_supply" for r in receipts) == 1
        rejected = [r["result"] for r in receipts if r["tool"] == "restaurant.contract_rejected"]
        assert len(rejected) == 1 and rejected[0]["code"] == failure

        mode = calls[0]["request_body"]["config"]["tool_config"]["function_calling_config"]

"""Memory profiles constrain recall while typed evidence stays scoped and durable."""

import hashlib

from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError

def fact(**changes):
    return {
        "id": 17,
        "fact_id": 17,
        "key": "restaurant.order:meal-a",
        "owner_role": "restaurant",
        "context_type": "order",
        "context_id": "meal-a",
        "kind": "restaurant.order",
        "subject": "meal-a",
        "version": 2,
        "body": {"status": "cooking", "action": "restaurant_approved"},
        "observed_sim": 5,
        "expires_sim": 3605,
        "event_id": 101,
        "previous_id": 16,
        **changes,
    }


def test_profiles_are_frozen_bounded_and_do_not_change_authority() -> None:
    profile = MemoryProfile()
    assert profile.model_dump() == {
        "mode": "typed",
        "max_facts": 8,
        "max_bytes": 8192,
        "ttl_seconds": 3600,
    }
    with pytest.raises((ValidationError, FrozenInstanceError)):
        profile.mode = "none"
    role = load_role("inventory")
    changed = role.model_copy(update={"memory": profile})
    assert changed.tools == role.tools and changed.accepts == role.accepts
    assert changed.digest != role.digest


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "changes",
    [
        {"mode": "vector"},

def test_legacy_role_hash_and_supply_dump_stay_identical_when_unconfigured() -> None:
    role = load_role("inventory")

    legacy = role.model_dump(mode="json")

    legacy.pop("memory")
    expected = hashlib.sha256(

    ).hexdigest()

def test_projection_formats_retain_sources_and_raw_facts() -> None:
    facts = [fact()]
    before = deepcopy(facts)
    assert project_memory(None, facts) is facts
    assert project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode="typed"), facts) is facts
    assert project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode="none"), facts) == []
    text = project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode="text"), facts)
    assert isinstance(text, str)
    assert "restaurant.order meal-a" in text and "event=101" in text and "version=2" in text
    assert "fact=17" in text and '"context_id":"meal-a"' in text
    structured = project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode="json"), facts)
    assert isinstance(structured, dict)
    assert structured["scope"]["context_id"] == "meal-a"
    assert structured["facts"][0]["body"] == facts[0]["body"]
    assert structured["facts"][0]["provenance"] == {
        "fact_id": 17,
        "version": 2,
        "event_id": 101,
        "observed_sim": 5,
        "expires_sim": 3605,
        "previous_id": 16,
    }
    assert facts == before


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["text", "json", "typed"])
def test_projection_caps_count_and_utf8_bytes_without_partial_facts(mode: str) -> None:
    facts = [fact(fact_id=number, event_id=number) for number in range(1, 9)]
    result = project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode=mode, max_facts=1), facts)
    if isinstance(result, list):
        assert len(result) == 1
    elif isinstance(result, dict):
        assert len(result["facts"]) == 1
    else:
        assert result.count("event=") == 1
    large = [fact(body={"status": "cooking", "reason": "á" * 240})]
    result = project_memory(MemoryProfile(mode=mode, max_bytes=256), large)
    serialized = (
        result
        if isinstance(result, str)
        else json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    )
    assert len(serialized.encode("utf-8")) <= 256
    assert result in (
        [],
        "",
        {
            "scope": {"owner_role": "restaurant", "context_type": "order", "context_id": "meal-a"},
            "facts": [],
        },
    )
    assert large[0]["body"]["reason"] == "á" * 240

def set_profile(db_url: str, fleet: Fleet, profile: MemoryProfile) -> None:
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE agent_bindings SET definition=jsonb_set(definition,'{memory}',%s) "
            "WHERE run_id=%s AND store='store-1'",

        )


def record(conn, event, status="reserved", ttl=3600):
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT agent_memory_record(%s,%s,%s,'inventory.reservation',%s,%s) data",
        (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, Jsonb({"status": status}), ttl),
    ).fetchone()["data"]


def recall(conn, event, limit=8):
    return conn.execute(
        "SELECT agent_memory_recall(%s,%s,%s,NULL,%s) data",
        (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, limit),
    ).fetchone()["data"]


@pytest.mark.integration
@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["none", "text", "json", "typed"])
def test_sql_modes_keep_typed_audit_and_scoped_array_receipts(
    db_url: str, fleet: Fleet, mode: str
) -> None:
    set_profile(db_url, fleet, MemoryProfile(mode=mode, ttl_seconds=60))
    request(db_url, fleet)
    request(db_url, fleet, basket="b")
    request(db_url, fleet, store="store-2", basket="a", key="peer-a")
    event, other = claim(fleet), claim(fleet)
    peer = claim(fleet, "store-2")
    agent = fleet.agents["store-1"]
    assert agent.reserve_budget(event) and agent.reserve_budget(other)
    assert fleet.agents["store-2"].reserve_budget(peer)
    with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
        written = record(conn, event)
        assert written["expires_sim"] == 60 and written["event_id"] == event.id
        seen = recall(conn, event)
        assert isinstance(seen, list)
        assert seen == ([] if mode == "none" else [written])
        assert recall(conn, other) == []
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            recall(conn, peer)
        for function, extra in (
            ("agent_memory_recall_typed", ""),
            ("agent_memory_record_typed", ",'inventory.reservation','{\"status\":\"reserved\"}'"),
        ):
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                conn.execute(
                    f"SELECT {function}(%s,%s,%s{extra})",
                    (event.id, event.token, event.attempts),
                )
    with connect(fleet.agents["store-2"].dsn) as conn:
        assert recall(conn, peer) == []
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        stored = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM agent_memory_facts WHERE run_id=%s", (fleet.run,)
        ).fetchall()
        assert len(stored) == 1 and stored[0]["body"] == {"status": "reserved"}
        conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=60 WHERE id=%s", (fleet.run,))
    with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
        assert recall(conn, event) == []

import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from uuid import UUID

import pytest

from delivery.db import Connection, connect
from delivery.queue import Backpressure, Event, Queue, publish

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration


def test_fresh_events_are_ready_without_wall_clock_gating(db_url: str, run_id: UUID) -> None:
    event_id = send(db_url, run_id)
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT available_at FROM events WHERE id=%s", (event_id,)).fetchone()
        assert row and row["available_at"].year == 1970
    event = Queue(db_url).claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert event and event.id == event_id


def test_lease_cannot_survive_waiting_for_run_lock(db_url: str, run_id: UUID) -> None:
    send(db_url, run_id)
    queue = Queue(db_url, lease_seconds=0.1)
    event = queue.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert event
    called = []
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(%s,0))", (str(run_id),))
            task = pool.submit(queue.process, event, lambda c, e: called.append(e.id))
            time.sleep(0.25)
            assert not task.done()
            # Docker's clock can pause relative to the host under load. Expire using
            # the database clock while the worker is still fenced by the run lock.
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE events SET lease_until=clock_timestamp()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=%s",
                (event.id,),
            )
        assert not task.result()
    assert called == []


def send(url: str, run: UUID, key: str = "o1", priority: int = 0, capacity: int = 100) -> int:
    with connect(url) as conn:
        return publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run,
            producer="generator",
            topic="order.created",
            payload={"order_id": key},
            key=key,
            trace_id=key,
            priority=priority,
            capacity=capacity,
        )


def test_concurrent_dedupe_and_claim(db_url: str, run_id: UUID) -> None:
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        ids = list(pool.map(lambda _: send(db_url, run_id), range(16)))
    assert len(set(ids)) == 1
    q = Queue(db_url)
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=8) as pool:
        events = list(pool.map(lambda _: q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0), range(8)))
    assert len([e for e in events if e]) == 1


def test_retry_rollback_dlq_and_replay(db_url: str, run_id: UUID) -> None:
    event_id = send(db_url, run_id)
    q = Queue(db_url)

    def broken(conn: Connection, event: Event) -> None:
        conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=999 WHERE id=%s", (run_id,))
        raise ValueError("secret-looking text must never be stored")

    for attempt in range(3):
        event = q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
        assert event and event.attempts == attempt + 1
        assert not q.process(event, broken)
        if attempt < 2:
            assert q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0) is None  # backoff is real
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE events SET available_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (event_id,))
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        assert conn.execute("SELECT sim_time FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (run_id,)).fetchone() == {
            "sim_time": 0
        }
        row = conn.execute("SELECT error FROM dead_letters WHERE id=%s", (event_id,)).fetchone()
        assert row == {"error": "ValueError"}
    assert q.replay(event_id)
    event = q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert event and q.process(event, lambda conn, e: None)
    assert not q.process(event, lambda conn, e: pytest.fail("duplicate handler"))


def test_fencing_priority_capacity_and_permissions(db_url: str, run_id: UUID) -> None:
    send(db_url, run_id, "low", priority=1, capacity=2)
    send(db_url, run_id, "high", priority=10, capacity=2)
    send(db_url, run_id, "low", capacity=2)  # dedupe does not consume capacity
    with pytest.raises(Backpressure):
        send(db_url, run_id, "overflow", capacity=2)
    with connect(db_url) as conn, pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run_id,
            producer="courier",
            topic="order.created",
            payload={},
            key="bad",
            trace_id="bad",
        )
    q = Queue(db_url)
    old = q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert old and old.payload["order_id"] == "high"
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE events SET lease_until=now()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=%s", (old.id,)
        )
    new = q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert new and new.id == old.id and new.token != old.token
    assert not q.process(old, lambda c, e: pytest.fail("stale handler"))
    assert q.process(new, lambda c, e: None)


def test_crashing_workers_eventually_dead_letter(db_url: str, run_id: UUID) -> None:
    event_id = send(db_url, run_id)
    q = Queue(db_url)
    for _ in range(3):
        assert q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE events SET lease_until=now()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=%s", (event_id,)
            )
    assert q.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0) is None
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        assert conn.execute("SELECT id FROM dead_letters WHERE id=%s", (event_id,)).fetchone()

def complaint_event(url: str, run: UUID, key: str, requested: float = 0) -> Event:
    with connect(url) as conn:

        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run,
            producer="generator",
            topic="complaint.created",

    with connect(db_url) as conn:

        assert conn.execute(

def test_concurrent_llm_budget_is_durable(
    db_url: str, run_id: UUID, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    events = [complaint_event(db_url, run_id, str(i)) for i in range(2)]
    config = Settings(llm_provider="gemini", llm_max_calls=1)
    service = CustomerService(db_url, config)
    calls: list[int] = []

"""Scenario scores must expose failures, omissions, drift and failed repeat attempts."""

from delivery.scenario_report import (
    ROOT,
    Manifest,
    Outcome,
    digest,
    load_manifest,
    outcome_hash,
    summarize,
    validate_receipt,
)


def receipt():
    manifest = load_manifest()
    results = [
        Outcome(id=c.id, observed={k.id: k.expected for k in c.checks}) for c in manifest.cases
    ]
    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "kind": "agent-scenarios",
        "mode": "local-deterministic",
        "version": manifest.version,
        "seed": manifest.seed,
        "fixture_hash": digest(manifest.model_dump(mode="json")),
        "source_fingerprint": "a" * 64,
        "source_changed": False,
        "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
        "configurations": {c.fixture: "b" * 64 for c in manifest.cases},
        "results": [row.model_dump() for row in results],
        "reproduction": {"repetitions": 1, "hashes": [outcome_hash(results)]},
    }


def rehash(value):
    repeats = [*value["reproduction"].get("previous_results", []), value["results"]]
    value["reproduction"].setdefault(
        "previous_configurations", [copy.deepcopy(value["configurations"]) for _ in repeats[:-1]]
    )
    value["reproduction"]["hashes"] = [
        outcome_hash([Outcome.model_validate(row) for row in rows]) for rows in repeats
    ]
    return value


def report(value):
    manifest = load_manifest()
    return summarize(manifest, validate_receipt(rehash(value), manifest))


def test_manifest_scenarios_are_separate_from_test_counts_and_cover_all_roles():
    result = report(receipt())
    assert result["counts"] == {"total": 12, "passed": 12, "failed": 0, "not_measured": 0}
    assert {r["id"] for r in result["roles"]} == {
        "inventory",
        "restaurant",
        "dispatcher",
        "courier",
    }
    assert all(r["score"] == 100 and r["status"] == "passed" for r in result["roles"])
    assert result["checks_total"] == 49

    assert case["checks"][0] == {
        "id": "winners",
        "label": "Baskets reserved from the last unit",
        "expected": 1,
        "actual": 2,
        "repetition": 1,
        "status": "failed",

def test_real_embedding_semantically_matches_paraphrase_over_unrelated_observation():
    vectors = LocalEmbedder().embed([
        "Has the kitchen already held ingredients for this meal?",
        "The restaurant reserved stock to prepare the order.",
        "The bicycle courier has arrived at the customer's address.",
    ])
    import numpy as np

    query, relevant, unrelated = map(np.array, vectors)
    def cosine(v):
        return float(query @ v / (np.linalg.norm(query) * np.linalg.norm(v)))

    assert cosine(relevant) > cosine(unrelated) + 0.1

"""Delivery projection facts survive household termination and roll back atomically."""

from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

import psycopg
import pytest

import delivery.supply as supply
from delivery.agent_access import retire_inventory_access
from delivery.agent_runtime import LocalAgent
from delivery.db import connect
from delivery.delivery_flow import new_delivery
from delivery.fleet_flow import advance_fleet
from delivery.queue import Event
from delivery.supply_models import SupplyConfig, default_config

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration


@dataclass
class DeliveryFactsRun:
    run: str
    url: str


@pytest.fixture
def delivery_facts_run(db_url: str) -> Iterator[Callable[..., DeliveryFactsRun]]:
    runs: list[str] = []

    def create(*, is_supply: bool = True) -> DeliveryFactsRun:
        if is_supply:
            raw = default_config().model_dump(mode="json")
            home = next(e for e in raw["entities"] if e["kind"] == "household")
            home.update(node=0, recipe_ids=["pizza"])
            kitchen = next(e for e in raw["entities"] if e["id"] == "restaurant-pizza")
            kitchen["node"] = 1
            markets = [e for e in raw["entities"] if e["kind"] == "market"]
            for index, market in enumerate(markets):
                market["node"] = index + 2
            raw.update(
                entities=[home, kitchen, *markets],
                start_hour=12,
                duration_minutes=15,
                playback_seconds=0,
                calls_per_household=1,
                restaurant_stock_servings=1,
            )
            run = supply.new_supply(SupplyConfig.model_validate(raw), db_url)
        else:
            run = new_delivery(url=db_url)
        runs.append(run)
        return DeliveryFactsRun(run, db_url)

    yield create
    for run in runs:
        with supply._LOCK:
            for key in list(supply._AGENTS):
                if key[0] == run:
                    del supply._AGENTS[key]
            for token, grant in list(supply._TOKENS.items()):
                if grant[0] == run:
                    del supply._TOKENS[token]
        retire_inventory_access(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM decisions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (run,))
            assert (
                conn.execute(
                    "SELECT count(*) n FROM supply_facts WHERE run_id=%s",
                    (run,),
                ).fetchone()["n"]
                == 0
            )


def claim(agent: LocalAgent) -> Event:
    event = agent.claim()
    assert event is not None
    return event


def clock(run: DeliveryFactsRun, sim: int) -> None:
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=%s WHERE id=%s", (sim, run.run))


def test_world_and_dispatcher_after_terminal_household_still_replay_exactly(
    delivery_facts_run: Callable[..., DeliveryFactsRun],
) -> None:
    run = delivery_facts_run()
    agents = supply.provision(run.run, run.url)
    home = next(a for a in agents.values() if a.role.name == "household")
    kitchen, dispatcher = agents["restaurant-pizza"], agents["dispatcher:fleet"]
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        schedule = conn.execute(
            "SELECT config->'schedule' schedule FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchone()["schedule"]
    clock(run, 900)
    supply.release_calls(run.run, schedule, 900, run.url)
    assert home.process(claim(home))
    clock(run, 1000)
    assert kitchen.process(claim(kitchen))
    clock(run, 1100)
    cooking = claim(kitchen)
    assert cooking.topic == "restaurant.cook" and kitchen.process(cooking)
    clock(run, 1200)
    ready = claim(dispatcher)
    assert ready.topic == "basket.ready" and dispatcher.process(ready)
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        job = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM lab_delivery_jobs WHERE run_id=%s",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchone()
    courier = agents[f"courier:{job['courier']}"]
    briefing = claim(courier)
    assert briefing.topic == "courier.briefed" and courier.process(briefing)
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        # Inject a deadline that expires while this accepted physical trip is in
        # progress. The subsequent household command records the order after-image.
        conn.execute("UPDATE supply_orders SET deadline=1201 WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,))
        conn.execute("UPDATE lab_delivery_jobs SET deadline_sim=1201 WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,))
        job = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM lab_delivery_jobs WHERE run_id=%s",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchone()
        assert job["accepted"] and job["arrive_sim"] > 1202
    clock(run, 1202)
    observation = claim(home)
    assert observation.topic == "meal.delivery" and home.process(observation)
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM supply_orders WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["status"]
            == "failed"
        )
    # Real world motion and the real dispatcher now mutate the job after the
    # household's final fact. Each change must enter the same canonical ledger.
    advance_fleet(run.run, job["arrive_sim"] + 1, run.url, dropouts=set())
    for _ in range(4):
        event = dispatcher.claim()
        if event is None:
            break
        assert dispatcher.process(event)
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM lab_delivery_jobs WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["status"]
            == "delivered"
        )
        changes = conn.execute(
            """SELECT actor,event_id,payload->'detail'->>'status' status FROM supply_facts
            WHERE run_id=%s AND kind='delivery.job.changed' ORDER BY sequence""",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchall()
        assert all(change["event_id"] is None for change in changes)
        assert any(c["actor"] == "lab_world" and c["status"] == "arrived" for c in changes)
        assert any(c["actor"] == "dispatcher:fleet" and c["status"] == "delivered" for c in changes)
    replay = supply.replay_supply(run.run, run.url)
    assert replay["matches"] and replay["hash_chain_valid"]
    assert all(replay["projections"].values())


def insert_job(conn: Any, run: DeliveryFactsRun, basket: str = "trigger-probe") -> None:
    conn.execute(
        """INSERT INTO lab_delivery_jobs(run_id,basket,store,pickup_node,customer_node)
        VALUES(%s,%s,'restaurant-pizza',1,0)""",
        (run.run, basket),
    )


def test_delivery_facts_roll_back_with_job_changes_and_skip_noop_updates(
    delivery_facts_run: Callable[..., DeliveryFactsRun],
) -> None:
    run = delivery_facts_run()
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Injected"), connect(run.url) as conn:
        insert_job(conn, run)
        raise RuntimeError("Injected failure before commit")
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) n FROM lab_delivery_jobs WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 0
        )
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) n FROM supply_facts WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 0
        )
        insert_job(conn, run)
    with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Injected"), connect(run.url) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE lab_delivery_jobs SET status='deferred' WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,))
        raise RuntimeError("Injected failure after update")
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM lab_delivery_jobs WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["status"]
            == "ready"
        )
        conn.execute("UPDATE lab_delivery_jobs SET status=status WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,))
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) n FROM supply_facts WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 1
        )
    assert supply.replay_supply(run.run, run.url)["matches"]


def test_non_supply_delivery_jobs_do_not_generate_supply_facts(
    delivery_facts_run: Callable[..., DeliveryFactsRun],
) -> None:
    run = delivery_facts_run(is_supply=False)
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        insert_job(conn, run)
        conn.execute("UPDATE lab_delivery_jobs SET status='deferred' WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,))
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) n FROM supply_facts WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 0
        )


def test_supply_roles_cannot_execute_the_trigger_helper_or_mutate_jobs_directly(
    delivery_facts_run: Callable[..., DeliveryFactsRun],
) -> None:
    run = delivery_facts_run()
    agents = supply.provision(run.run, run.url)
    for role in ("household", "restaurant", "market", "dispatcher", "courier", "judge"):
        agent = next(a for a in agents.values() if a.role.name == role)
        with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
            assert not conn.execute(
                """SELECT has_function_privilege(current_user,
                'public.supply_record_delivery_job()','EXECUTE') allowed""",
            ).fetchone()["allowed"]
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                conn.execute("SELECT public.supply_record_delivery_job()")
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                insert_job(conn, run)

"""Supply behavior and authority checks against real scoped PostgreSQL logins."""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

import psycopg
import pytest
from psycopg.types.json import Jsonb

from delivery.agent_access import retire_inventory_access
from delivery.agent_runtime import LocalAgent, ScopedTools
from delivery.db import Connection, connect
from delivery.queue import Event, Queue
from delivery.supply import new_supply, provision, release_calls, replay_supply, run_supply
from delivery.supply_models import SupplyConfig, default_config

pytestmark = pytest.mark.integration


@dataclass
class SupplyRun:
    run: str
    config: SupplyConfig
    url: str

    @property
    def household(self) -> str:
        return next(e.id for e in self.config.entities if e.kind == "household")

    @property
    def restaurant(self) -> str:
        return next(e.id for e in self.config.entities if e.kind == "restaurant")


def small_config(
    *,
    meal: str = "pizza",
    households: int = 1,
    pantry: int = 0,
    markets: int = 3,
    allow: bool = True,
    excluded: tuple[str, ...] = (),
) -> SupplyConfig:
    """Use real entity definitions with short connected routes and one meal choice."""
    base = default_config()
    homes = [e for e in base.entities if e.kind == "household"][:households]
    restaurant = next(e for e in base.entities if e.id == f"restaurant-{meal}")
    shops = [e for e in base.entities if e.kind == "market"]
    entities = [
        e.model_copy(
            update={
                "node": 0,
                "recipe_ids": (meal,),
                "allow_substitutions": allow,
                "excluded_ingredients": excluded,
            }
        )
        for e in homes
    ]
    entities.append(restaurant.model_copy(update={"node": 1}))
    entities.extend(e.model_copy(update={"node": index + 2}) for index, e in enumerate(shops))
    candidate = base.model_copy(
        update={
            "entities": tuple(entities),
            "start_hour": 12,
            "duration_minutes": 15,
            "playback_seconds": 0,
            "calls_per_household": 1,
            "restaurant_stock_servings": pantry,
            "market_stock_servings": markets,
        }
    )
    return SupplyConfig.model_validate(candidate.model_dump(mode="json"))


@pytest.fixture
def supply_run(db_url: str) -> Iterator[Callable[..., SupplyRun]]:
    runs: list[str] = []

    def create(**options: Any) -> SupplyRun:
        config = small_config(**options)
        run = new_supply(config, db_url)
        runs.append(run)
        return SupplyRun(run, config, db_url)

    yield create
    for run in runs:
        retire_inventory_access(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            # Fact rows reference queue events. Remove the run's domain through its
            # parent first, so those references cannot block normal run cleanup.
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM supply_requests WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM decisions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (run,))


def opening_stock(run: SupplyRun) -> None:
    """Freeze an operator-injected stock scenario before releasing any demand."""
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        frozen = conn.execute(
            """SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) ORDER BY owner,ingredient) stock
            FROM supply_stock s WHERE run_id=%s""",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchone()["stock"]
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE supply_sessions SET opening=jsonb_set(opening,'{stock}',%s) WHERE run_id=%s",
            (Jsonb(frozen), run.run),
        )


def release(run: SupplyRun, sim: int = 900) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        schedule = conn.execute(
            "SELECT config->'schedule' schedule FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,)
        ).fetchone()["schedule"]
        conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=%s WHERE id=%s", (sim, run.run))
    release_calls(run.run, schedule, sim, run.url)
    return schedule


def claim(agent: LocalAgent) -> Event:
    event = agent.claim()
    assert event is not None
    return event


def drain_kitchen(run: SupplyRun, agents: dict[str, LocalAgent]) -> None:
    """Drain supply events through cooking; keep delivery observation for the world."""
    for _ in range(200):
        with connect(run.url) as conn:
            row = conn.execute(
                """SELECT target_store,due_sim FROM events WHERE run_id=%s AND state='ready'
                AND topic NOT IN ('basket.ready','meal.delivery')
                ORDER BY due_sim,id LIMIT 1""",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()
            if not row:
                return
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE runs SET sim_time=greatest(sim_time,%s) WHERE id=%s",
                (row["due_sim"], run.run),
            )
        agent = agents[row["target_store"]]
        assert agent.process(claim(agent))
    raise AssertionError("Kitchen event drain exceeded its bounded step count")


def test_completed_supplier_memory_expires_but_keeps_revision_history(
    supply_run: Callable[..., SupplyRun],
) -> None:
    run = supply_run()
    state = run_supply(run.run, run.url)
    assert state["orders"][0]["status"] == "delivered"
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM agent_memory_facts WHERE run_id=%s AND kind='market.request' "
            "ORDER BY id",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchall()
        by_id = {row["id"]: row for row in rows}
        assert len(rows) == 8
        assert any(
            row["body"]["outcome"] == "supplier_reserved"
            and row["expires_sim"] > state["run"]["sim_time"]
            for row in rows
        )
        for row in rows:
            if row["body"]["outcome"] == "supplier_reserved":
                assert row["expires_sim"] - row["observed_sim"] == 3600
            else:
                assert row["body"]["outcome"] == "supplier_dispatched"
                assert row["expires_sim"] - row["observed_sim"] == 60
                assert by_id[row["previous_id"]]["subject"] == row["subject"]
                assert row["expires_sim"] <= state["run"]["sim_time"]
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) n FROM agent_memory_current WHERE run_id=%s "
                "AND kind='market.request' AND expires_sim>%s",
                (run.run, state["run"]["sim_time"]),
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 0
        )


def test_real_supply_roles_deny_raw_state_forgery_and_cross_household_memory(
    supply_run: Callable[..., SupplyRun],
) -> None:
    run = supply_run(households=2)
    agents = provision(run.run, run.url)
    schedule = release(run)
    homes = [e.id for e in run.config.entities if e.kind == "household"]
    a, b = agents[homes[0]], agents[homes[1]]
    ea, eb = claim(a), claim(b)
    assert a.reserve_budget(ea) and b.reserve_budget(eb)
    other_order = next(o["order_id"] for o in schedule if o["household"] == homes[1])
    for agent in (a, agents[run.restaurant], agents["market-a"]):
        with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
            for statement in (
                "SELECT * FROM supply_stock",
                "SELECT * FROM lab_stock",
                "SELECT * FROM supply_facts",
                "UPDATE supply_facts SET actor=actor",
                "DELETE FROM supply_facts",
                "UPDATE events SET payload=payload",
                "UPDATE events SET target_store=target_store",
                "SET ROLE delivery",
            ):
                with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                    conn.execute(statement)
            with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                conn.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO events(run_id,producer,topic,payload,dedupe_key,
                    trace_id,target_store) VALUES (%s,'household','household.call','{}',
                    'forged','forged',%s)""",
                    (run.run, run.restaurant),
                )
    with connect(a.dsn) as conn:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute("SELECT supply_context(%s)", (other_order,))
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute("SELECT supply_command(%s,%s,%s)", (ea.id, uuid4(), ea.attempts))
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute("SELECT supply_command(%s,%s,%s)", (eb.id, eb.token, eb.attempts))
        tools = ScopedTools(conn, a.scope, a.role, ea)
        tools.invoke(
            "memory.write", kind="household.order", body={"status": "calling", "action": "calling"}
        )
        assert tools.invoke("memory.read")[0]["body"] == {"status": "calling", "action": "calling"}
    with connect(b.dsn) as conn:
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute("SELECT * FROM agent_memories")
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute(
                """INSERT INTO agent_memories(run_id,store,key,body,observed_sim,
                expires_sim,event_id) VALUES (%s,%s,'forged','{}',900,1000,%s)""",
                (run.run, homes[0], eb.id),
            )


def test_supply_stock_facts_memory_and_outgoing_events_roll_back_before_ack(
    supply_run: Callable[..., SupplyRun],
) -> None:
    run = supply_run(pantry=1)
    agents = provision(run.run, run.url)

def test_complete_run_replays_without_agents_and_detects_fact_hash_corruption(
    supply_run: Callable[..., SupplyRun],
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    run = supply_run()
    state = run_supply(run.run, run.url)
    assert state["metrics"]["delivered"] == 1
    assert state["metrics"]["model_provider"] == "disabled"
    assert state["run"]["status"] == "complete"
    assert state["invariants"]["stock_conserved"]

    def no_provider_or_agent(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("Replay must not execute agents or providers")

    monkeypatch.setattr("delivery.supply.provision", no_provider_or_agent)
    replay = replay_supply(run.run, run.url)
    assert replay["matches"] and replay["hash_chain_valid"]
    assert replay["facts"] > 0 and replay["model_calls"] == 0
    assert all(replay["projections"].values())
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        fact = conn.execute(
            "SELECT sequence,hash FROM supply_facts WHERE run_id=%s ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchone()
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE supply_facts SET hash=%s WHERE run_id=%s AND sequence=%s",
            ("f" * 64, run.run, fact["sequence"]),
        )
    try:
        corrupted = replay_supply(run.run, run.url)
        assert not corrupted["hash_chain_valid"] and not corrupted["matches"]
    finally:
        with connect(run.url) as conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE supply_facts SET hash=%s WHERE run_id=%s AND sequence=%s",
                (fact["hash"], run.run, fact["sequence"]),
            )


def test_controller_retries_a_worker_failure_without_duplicate_stock_effects(
    supply_run: Callable[..., SupplyRun], monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    from delivery.supply_policy import SupplyPolicy

    run = supply_run(pantry=1)
    original = SupplyPolicy.decide
    crashed = False

    def fail_once(self: SupplyPolicy, event: Event, tools: ScopedTools) -> dict[str, Any]:
        nonlocal crashed
        if not crashed and event.topic == "restaurant.cook":
            crashed = True
            tools.invoke("supply.command")
            raise RuntimeError("Synthetic crash after inventory mutation before commit")
        return original(self, event, tools)

    monkeypatch.setattr(SupplyPolicy, "decide", fail_once)
    state = run_supply(run.run, run.url)
    assert crashed and state["run"]["status"] == "complete"
    assert state["metrics"]["delivered"] == 1
    assert state["invariants"]["stock_nonnegative"]
    assert state["invariants"]["stock_conserved"]
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT attempts FROM events WHERE run_id=%s AND topic='restaurant.cook'",
                (run.run,),
            ).fetchone()["attempts"]
            == 2
        )
        assert (
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT count(*) n FROM lab_delivery_jobs WHERE run_id=%s", (run.run,)
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            == 1
        )
        assert conn.execute(
            "SELECT step_slots,events_limit,tools_limit FROM agent_budgets "
            "WHERE run_id=%s AND store='dispatcher:fleet'",

        ).fetchone() == {"step_slots": 6, "events_limit": 333, "tools_limit": 2000}

@dataclass
class SearchRun:
    run: str
    url: str
    agents: dict[str, LocalAgent]
    agent: LocalAgent

@pytest.fixture
def search_run(db_url: str) -> Iterator[Callable[..., SearchRun]]:
    runs: list[str] = []

    def create(
        *,
        role: str = "restaurant",
        provider: str = "local",
        calls: int = 0,
        households: int = 1,
        tool_slots: int = 5,
        empty_flour: bool = False,
    ) -> SearchRun:
        raw = default_config().model_dump(mode="json")
        homes = [e for e in raw["entities"] if e["kind"] == "household"][:households]
        kitchen = next(e for e in raw["entities"] if e["id"] == "restaurant-pizza")
        markets = [e for e in raw["entities"] if e["kind"] == "market"]
        for home in homes:
            home.update(node=0, recipe_ids=["pizza"])
        kitchen["node"] = 1
        for index, market in enumerate(markets):
            market["node"] = index + 2
        raw.update(
            entities=homes + [kitchen] + markets,
            start_hour=12,
            duration_minutes=15,
            playback_seconds=0,
            calls_per_household=1,
        )
        for definition in raw["agents"].values():
            definition["search"] = {
                "provider": provider,
                "calls_limit": calls,
                "input_tokens_limit": 51200 if provider == "jev" else 0,
            }
            definition["limits"]["tool_calls_per_event"] = tool_slots
        config = SupplyConfig.model_validate(raw)
        run = new_supply(config, db_url)
        runs.append(run)
        if empty_flour:
            with connect(db_url) as conn:
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE supply_stock SET on_hand=0 WHERE run_id=%s
                    AND owner='market-a' AND ingredient='flour'""",
                    (run,),
                )
        agents = provision(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            schedule = conn.execute(
                "SELECT config->'schedule' schedule FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s",
                (run,),
            ).fetchone()["schedule"]
            conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=900 WHERE id=%s", (run,))
        release_calls(run, schedule, 900, db_url)
        for home in homes:
            agent = agents[home["id"]]
            event = agent.claim()
            assert event is not None and agent.process(event)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=1000 WHERE id=%s", (run,))
        agent = agents[kitchen["id"]]
        events = [agent.claim() for _ in homes]
        assert all(event is not None for event in events)
        if role == "market":
            for event in events:
                assert event is not None and agent.process(event)
            with connect(db_url) as conn:
                conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=1100 WHERE id=%s", (run,))
            agent = agents["market-a"]
            events = [agent.claim()]
            assert events[0] is not None
        return SearchRun(run, db_url, agents, agent, [e for e in events if e is not None])

    yield create
    for run in runs:
        with supply._LOCK:
            for key in list(supply._AGENTS):
                if key[0] == run:
                    del supply._AGENTS[key]
            for token, grant in list(supply._TOKENS.items()):
                if grant[0] == run:
                    del supply._TOKENS[token]
            for key in list(supply.CHANNEL_LEASES):
                if key[0] == run:
                    del supply.CHANNEL_LEASES[key]
        retire_inventory_access(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            # 012 fixes the cascading domain references as well as event/fact
            # cleanup. Real requests and facts exist in each market fixture.
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM decisions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (run,))

def review(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "model": payload["model"],
        "answers": {
            key: {
                "choice": "yes" if q["instructions"]["candidate"] == "Flour" else "no",
                "confidence": 0.9,
            }
            for key, q in payload["questions"].items()
        },
        "usage": {"input_tokens": 100, "output_tokens": 5},
    }

def test_search_denies_forged_expired_and_cross_entity_leases_and_raw_tables(
    search_run: Callable[..., SearchRun],
) -> None:
    run = search_run()
    agent, event = run.agent, run.events[0]
    for forged in (replace(event, token=uuid4()), replace(event, attempts=event.attempts + 1)):
        with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
            search_for_agent(agent, forged, "flour", "local")
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        search_for_agent(run.agents["market-a"], event, "flour", "local")
    home = next(a for a in run.agents.values() if a.role.name == "household")
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        search_for_agent(home, event, "flour", "local")
    with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
        for table in (
            "supply_search_budgets",
            "supply_search_calls",
            "supply_search_cache",
            "supply_search_tickets",
            "supply_search_audits",
        ):
            for operation in ("SELECT * FROM", "DELETE FROM"):
                with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
                    conn.execute(f"{operation} {table}")
        with pytest.raises(psycopg.errors.InsufficientPrivilege), conn.transaction():
            conn.execute(
                "SELECT supply_search_scope(%s,%s,%s)", (event.id, event.token, event.attempts)
            )
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE events SET lease_until=now()-interval '1 second' WHERE id=%s", (event.id,)
        )
    with pytest.raises(PermissionError):
        search_for_agent(agent, event, "flour", "local")

def test_cache_is_private_relevance_only_and_availability_refreshes_without_network(
    search_run: Callable[..., SearchRun],
    jev_env: None,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    run = search_run(role="market", provider="jev", calls=8, tool_slots=8, empty_flour=True)
    agent, event = run.agent, run.events[0]
    login = conninfo_to_dict(agent.dsn)["user"]
    network_calls: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    def mock_review(self: JevClient, payload: dict[str, Any], **kwargs: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        network_calls.append(payload)
        serialized = json.dumps(payload)
        assert "customer-" not in serialized and "available" not in serialized
        assert "market-a" not in serialized and "reserved" not in serialized
        assert "synthetic-test-key" not in serialized
        with connect(run.url) as conn:
            assert (
                conn.execute(
                    """SELECT count(*) n FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename=%s
                AND xact_start IS NOT NULL""",
                    (login,),
                ).fetchone()["n"]
                == 0
            )
            if len(network_calls) == 1:
                # Change inventory while relevance is being reviewed. Availability
                # must be read again after review, rather than copied from begin.
                conn.execute(
                    """UPDATE supply_stock SET on_hand=100,version=4 WHERE run_id=%s
                    AND owner='market-a' AND ingredient='flour'""",
                    (run.run,),
                )
        return review(payload)

    monkeypatch.setattr(JevClient, "__call__", mock_review)
    first = search_for_agent(agent, event, "flour", "jev")
    assert first["calls"] == 3 and first["results"][0]["available"] == 100
    assert first["results"][0]["stock_version"] == 4
    count = len(network_calls)
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE supply_stock SET on_hand=10,version=9 WHERE run_id=%s
            AND owner='market-a' AND ingredient='flour'""",
            (run.run,),
        )
    second = search_for_agent(agent, event, "flour", "jev")
    assert second["calls"] == 0 and second["cache_hits"] == 17
    assert len(network_calls) == count
    assert second["results"][0]["available"] == 10
    assert second["results"][0]["stock_version"] == 9
    assert not second["availability_is_reservation"]
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        cached = conn.execute(
            "SELECT body FROM supply_search_cache WHERE run_id=%s",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchall()
        assert len(cached) == 17
        assert all(
            set(row["body"]) == {"choice", "confidence", "model", "expires_at"}
            and row["body"]["choice"] in {"yes", "no"}
            for row in cached
        )
        conn.execute(
            """UPDATE supply_search_cache SET expires_at=now()-interval '1 second'
            WHERE run_id=%s AND owner='market-a'""",
            (run.run,),
        )
    expired = search_for_agent(agent, event, "flour", "jev")
    assert expired["cache_hits"] == 0 and expired["calls"] == 3
    assert agent.process(event)  # Ten grams cannot fill the 150g request; forward.
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=1200 WHERE id=%s", (run.run,))
    peer = run.agents["market-b"]
    peer_event = peer.claim()
    assert peer_event is not None
    peer_result = search_for_agent(peer, peer_event, "flour", "jev")
    assert peer_result["cache_hits"] == 0 and peer_result["calls"] == 3
    assert peer_result["error"] is None
    assert peer_result["results"][0]["available"] > 10
    with connect(run.url) as conn:
        owners = conn.execute(
            "SELECT owner,count(*) n FROM supply_search_cache WHERE run_id=%s GROUP BY owner",
            (run.run,),
        ).fetchall()
        assert {row["owner"] for row in owners} == {"market-a", "market-b"}
        # Relevance cache writes are best-effort. A missed write cannot widen
        # scope or change a provider result, and is retried as a cache miss.
        assert all(1 <= row["n"] <= 17 for row in owners)

    with telemetry.trace_span("request") as request:
        with telemetry.order_span("queue.publish", run_id="run", order_id="order") as root:
            parent = telemetry.current_traceparent()
            root_id = root.get_span_context().trace_id
        with telemetry.order_span("queue.publish", run_id="run", order_id="other") as other:
            assert other.get_span_context().trace_id != root_id
    with telemetry.order_span("queue.process", run_id="run", order_id="order", traceparent=parent):
        with telemetry.trace_span("agent.tool", attributes={"delivery.tool": "confirm_order"}):
            pass

        s
        for s in recorded
        if s.name == "queue.publish" and s.attributes["delivery.order_id"] == "order"
    )
    consumed = next(s for s in recorded if s.name == "queue.process")

    assert consumed.context.trace_id == published.context.trace_id == root_id
    assert consumed.parent.span_id == published.context.span_id
    assert tool.parent.span_id == consumed.context.span_id

@pytest.mark.integration
def test_queue_context_is_durable_through_sql_children_and_retry(
    db_url: str, run_id: UUID, spans
) -> None:
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run_id,
            producer="generator",
            topic="order.created",
            payload={"order_id": "one"},
            key="one",
            trace_id="one",
        )
    queue = Queue(db_url)
    first = queue.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert first and first.traceparent

    def handler(conn: Connection, event: Event) -> None:
        # Models SQL capability functions that publish without going through Python.
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO events(run_id,producer,topic,payload,dedupe_key,trace_id,parent_id) "
            "VALUES (%s,'dispatcher','courier.assigned','{}','child','one',%s)",
            (event.run_id, event.id),
        )

    assert queue.process(first, handler)
    child = queue.claim("courier", run_id, 0)
    assert child and child.traceparent and child.traceparent != first.traceparent

    def failed(conn: Connection, event: Event) -> None:
        raise RuntimeError("sensitive provider error")

    assert not queue.process(child, failed)
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE events SET available_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (child.id,))
    retry = queue.claim("courier", run_id, 0)
    assert retry and retry.traceparent == child.traceparent
    assert queue.process(retry, lambda conn, event: None)
    recorded = spans.get_finished_spans()
    assert {s.context.trace_id for s in recorded} == {telemetry.order_trace_id(run_id, "one")}
    assert len([s for s in recorded if s.name == "queue.process"]) == 3
    assert "sensitive" not in str(recorded)

    # A clock/world producer continues a stored parent after the consumer has exited.
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run_id,
            producer="courier",
            topic="order.delivered",
            payload={},
            key="world",
            trace_id="one",
            parent_id=child.id,
        )
        parent = conn.execute("SELECT traceparent FROM events WHERE id=%s", (child.id,)).fetchone()
    world = spans.get_finished_spans()[-1]
    assert world.name == "queue.publish"
    assert world.parent.span_id == int(parent["traceparent"].split("-")[2], 16)


@pytest.mark.integration
def test_real_offline_adk_exports_tools_usage_and_scoped_parent(db_url: str, spans) -> None:
    from delivery.adk_contracts import restaurant_template
    from delivery.agent_access import retire_inventory_access
    from delivery.supply import new_supply, provision, release_calls
    from delivery.supply_models import AgentDefinition, SupplyConfig, default_config

    base = default_config()
    brain, soul = restaurant_template()
    definition_data = base.agents["restaurant"].model_dump()
    definition_data["limits"]["tool_calls_per_event"] = 16
    definition = AgentDefinition.model_validate({**definition_data, "brain": brain, "soul": soul})
    data = base.model_dump(mode="json")
    home = next(entity for entity in data["entities"] if entity["kind"] == "household")
    home.update(node=0, recipe_ids=["pizza"])
    data["entities"] = [home] + [
        entity
        for entity in data["entities"]
        if entity["id"] == "restaurant-pizza" or entity["kind"] == "market"
    ]
    for entity in data["entities"]:
        if entity["kind"] == "restaurant":
            entity["agent"] = definition.model_dump(mode="json")
            entity["node"] = 1
    data.update(
        playback_seconds=0,
        calls_per_household=1,
        restaurant_stock_servings=3,
        start_hour=12,
        duration_minutes=15,
    )
    config = SupplyConfig.model_validate(data)
    run = new_supply(config, db_url)
    try:
        agents = provision(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            schedule = conn.execute(
                "SELECT config->'schedule' AS s FROM supply_sessions WHERE run_id=%s", (run,)
            ).fetchone()["s"]
            conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=900 WHERE id=%s", (run,))
        release_calls(run, schedule, 900, db_url)
        incoming = None
        for agent in agents.values():
            if agent.role.name == "household" and (event := agent.claim()):
                incoming = event
                assert agent.process(event)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            conn.execute("UPDATE runs SET sim_time=1000 WHERE id=%s", (run,))
        worked = False
        for agent in agents.values():
            if agent.role.name == "restaurant" and (event := agent.claim()):
                assert event.traceparent
                assert incoming
                with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
                    rejected = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT public.agent_trace_context(%s,%s,%s,%s) AS ok",
                        (incoming.id, incoming.token, incoming.attempts, event.traceparent),
                    ).fetchone()
                    assert rejected["ok"] is False  # Foreign target store is never mutable.
                assert agent.process(event)
                with connect(agent.dsn) as conn:
                    rejected = conn.execute(
                        "SELECT public.agent_trace_context(%s,%s,%s,%s) AS ok",
                        (event.id, event.token, event.attempts, event.traceparent),
                    ).fetchone()
                    assert rejected["ok"] is False  # An ACKed lease cannot mutate context.
                worked = True
                break
        assert worked
        recorded = spans.get_finished_spans()
        models = [s for s in recorded if s.name == "agent.model"]
        tools = [
            s
            for s in recorded
            if s.name == "agent.tool" and s.attributes.get("delivery.agent") == "restaurant"
        ]
        assert models and tools
        assert all(s.attributes.get("gen_ai.request.model") == "offline" for s in models)
        assert all(s.attributes.get("delivery.cost_usd") == 0 for s in models)
        assert all(s.attributes.get("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens") == 0 for s in models)
        assert any(s.attributes["delivery.tool"] == "finish_decision" for s in tools)
        assert {s.context.trace_id for s in models + tools} == {
            telemetry.order_trace_id(run, event.trace_id)
        }
        assert "contents" not in str([dict(s.attributes) for s in recorded])
    finally:
        retire_inventory_access(run, db_url)
        with connect(db_url) as conn:
            for table in ("supply_requests", "supply_sessions", "decisions", "events"):
                conn.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE run_id=%s", (run,))
            conn.execute("DELETE FROM runs WHERE id=%s", (run,))

    assert span.attributes == {"error.type": "RuntimeError", "delivery.success": False}
    assert span.status.description is None and not span.events


def test_trace_links_are_validated_and_mode_specific(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    trace_id = "123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0"
    monkeypatch.setenv("DELIVERY_OTEL_EXPORTER", "jaeger")
    assert telemetry.trace_url(trace_id) == f"http://localhost:16686/trace/{trace_id}"
    assert telemetry.trace_url("javascript:alert(1)") is None
    assert telemetry.trace_url("0" * 32) is None
    monkeypatch.setenv("DELIVERY_OTEL_EXPORTER", "gcp")
    monkeypatch.setenv("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT", "portfolio-demo")

    )


@pytest.mark.integration
def test_queue_persists_context_without_changing_payload_or_business_id(
    db_url: str, run_id: UUID, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        original_id = publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run_id,
            producer="generator",
            topic="order.created",
            payload={"secret": "DO_NOT_EXPORT"},
            key="root",
            trace_id="order-1",
        )
    queue = Queue(db_url)
    event = queue.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert event and event.otel_traceparent and event.id == original_id
    assert event.trace_id == "order-1" and event.payload == {"secret": "DO_NOT_EXPORT"}

    def handler(conn: Connection, incoming: Event, *, unused: bool) -> None:
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run_id,
            producer="dispatcher",
            topic="courier.assigned",
            payload={"courier_id": "courier-1"},
            key="child",
            trace_id=incoming.trace_id,
            parent_id=incoming.id,
        )

    # Wrapped handlers are common in customer service and must remain supported.
    assert queue.process(event, partial(handler, unused=True))
    child = queue.claim("courier", run_id, 0)
    assert child and child.otel_traceparent
    assert child.otel_traceparent.split("-")[1] == event.otel_traceparent.split("-")[1]
    finished = spans.get_finished_spans()
    producer = next(span for span in finished if span.name == "queue.publish")
    consumer = next(span for span in finished if span.name == "queue.process")
    assert consumer.parent and consumer.parent.span_id == producer.context.span_id
    assert "DO_NOT_EXPORT" not in str([span.attributes for span in finished])


@pytest.mark.integration
def test_retry_keeps_trace_context_and_records_failure(
    db_url: str, run_id: UUID, spans: InMemorySpanExporter
) -> None:
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        publish(
            conn,
            run_id=run_id,
            producer="generator",
            topic="order.created",
            payload={},
            key="retry",
            trace_id="retry",
        )
    queue = Queue(db_url)
    event = queue.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert event

    def broken(conn: Connection, incoming: Event) -> None:
        raise RuntimeError("credential=DO_NOT_EXPORT")

    assert not queue.process(event, broken)
    with connect(db_url) as conn:
        conn.execute("UPDATE events SET available_at=now() WHERE id=%s", (event.id,))
    retry = queue.claim("dispatcher", run_id, 0)
    assert retry and retry.attempts == 2 and retry.otel_traceparent == event.otel_traceparent
    assert queue.process(retry, lambda conn, event: None)
    consumers = [span for span in spans.get_finished_spans() if span.name == "queue.process"]
    assert consumers[0].status.status_code is StatusCode.ERROR
    assert consumers[0].context.trace_id == consumers[1].context.trace_id
    assert all(not span.events for span in spans.get_finished_spans())
